// ============================================================================
// 25 SORTER: procedural pixel sprite (2 base views, mirrored for 4 facings),
// pose parameters, automatic outline with selective (sunlit) outline colours,
// billboard blit with depth, sunlight, rim light and lamp light.
// ============================================================================
const SW = 32, SHT = 36, AX = 16, AY = 34;           // sprite buffer, anchor = foot point
const SPR = new Uint8Array(SW * SHT), SPO = new Uint8Array(SW * SHT);   // colour, selective outline colour
const EMPTY = 255, OLF = 254;
const FACE_S = WORLD.FACE.S, FACE_E = WORLD.FACE.E, FACE_W = WORLD.FACE.W, FACE_N = WORLD.FACE.N;   // +y, +x, -x, -y
// Pose (all integers after quantisation), written each step by sim/14_world
const pose = WS.pose;
const ITEM_NONE = WORLD.ITEM.NONE, ITEM_OPENBOX = WORLD.ITEM.OPENBOX, ITEM_CATBOX = WORLD.ITEM.CATBOX, ITEM_CATARMS = WORLD.ITEM.CATARMS,
  ITEM_FLATBOX = WORLD.ITEM.FLATBOX, ITEM_MUG = WORLD.ITEM.MUG, ITEM_STAMP = WORLD.ITEM.STAMP;

function sprClear() { SPR.fill(EMPTY); }
function sp(x, y, c) { if (x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < SW && y < SHT) SPR[y * SW + x] = c; }
function rect(x, y, w, h, c) { for (let j = 0; j < h; j++) for (let i = 0; i < w; i++) sp(x + i, y + j, c); }
function run(x, y, w, c) { for (let i = 0; i < w; i++) sp(x + i, y, c); }
// Stamp an ASCII template; a key maps chars to palette indices ('.' = skip).
const KEY_S = new Uint8Array(128), KEY_I = new Uint8Array(128);   // the sorter, the things the sorter holds
let KEY = KEY_S;
function tpl(rows, x, y) {
  for (let j = 0; j < rows.length; j++) {
    const r = rows[j];
    for (let i = 0; i < r.length; i++) { const ch = r.charCodeAt(i); if (ch !== 46) sp(x + i, y + j, KEY[ch]); }
  }
}
function defKey(ch, c) { KEY[ch.charCodeAt(0)] = c; }
defKey('c', C.BL1); defKey('C', C.BL2); defKey('k', C.BL0); defKey('b', C.BR3);
defKey('h', C.WD0); defKey('H', C.WD1);
defKey('s', C.SK0); defKey('S', C.SK1); defKey('e', C.WD0); defKey('r', C.SK2);
defKey('w', C.CREAM); defKey('W', C.PAPSH);
defKey('m', C.CD0); defKey('M', C.CD1); defKey('o', C.CREAM); defKey('y', C.BR2);
defKey('l', C.WD1); defKey('L', C.WD2); defKey('d', C.WD0); defKey('q', C.BR3);
defKey('t', C.BL1); defKey('T', C.BL0); defKey('u', C.BL2);
defKey('f', C.WD0); defKey('F', C.WD1);

// Leg drawing: hip at (hx, hy), foot offset (fx, fy) relative to neutral.
function leg(hx, hy, fdx, fdy, near, toLeft) {
  const len = 7;
  for (let j = 0; j < len; j++) {
    const k = j / (len - 1), x = hx + Math.round(fdx * k), y = hy + j + Math.round(fdy * k);
    sp(x, y, near ? C.BL1 : C.BL0); sp(x + 1, y, near ? C.BL1 : C.BL0); sp(x + 2, y, near ? C.BL0 : C.BL0);
    if (near && j > 1 && j < len - 1) sp(x, y, C.BL2);
  }
  const fx = hx + fdx, fy = hy + len + fdy;
  if (toLeft) { run(fx - 1, fy, 4, C.WD0); run(fx - 1, fy - 1 + 1, 1, C.WD1); sp(fx, fy, C.WD1); }
  else { run(fx, fy, 4, C.WD0); sp(fx + 2, fy, C.WD1); }
}
// Arm: shoulder (sx, sy) to hand (hx, hy): 2-px sleeve (inner edge shaded), then a hand.
function arm(sx, sy, hx, hy, near) {
  const n = Math.max(Math.abs(hx - sx), Math.abs(hy - sy));
  for (let j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
    const k = n ? j / n : 0, x = Math.round(lerp(sx, hx, k)), y = Math.round(lerp(sy, hy, k));
    sp(x, y, near ? C.CD0 : C.CD1); sp(x + 1, y, near ? C.CD1 : C.WD1);
  }
  sp(hx, hy + 1, near ? C.SK0 : C.SK1); sp(hx + 1, hy + 1, C.SK1);
}
function satchel(x, y) {
  rect(x, y, 5, 4, C.WD1); run(x, y, 5, C.WD2); run(x, y + 1, 5, C.WD2);
  sp(x + 2, y + 1, C.BR3); sp(x, y + 3, C.WD0); sp(x + 4, y + 3, C.WD0);
}
// Things the sorter carries: kraft boxes (flat, half open, open), the collected ginger cat
// in its box or in the arms, the mug and the paw stamp. Templates sit on the near hand.
KEY = KEY_I;
defKey('K', C.KRAFT2); defKey('k', C.KRAFT); defKey('j', C.KRAFT0); defKey('D', C.DEEP); defKey('x', C.WD1);
defKey('g', C.CT1); defKey('G', C.CT2); defKey('h', C.CT0); defKey('E', C.PT2); defKey('N', C.RD4); defKey('w', C.WHITE);
KEY = KEY_S;
const HI_FLAT = ['KKKKKKKKKK', 'kkkkkkkkkj'];
const HI_HALF = ['.K.....K.', '.KKKKKKj.', '.kkkkkkj.', '.jjjjjjj.'];
const HI_OPEN = ['K.......K', '.KKKKKKj.', '.xDDDDDj.', '.KKKKKKj.', '.kkkkkkj.', '.kkkkkkj.', '.jjjjjjj.'];
const HI_CATBOX = ['..g...g..', '..ggGgg..', 'K.gEhEg.K', '.KgNwNgj.', '.xDwwwDj.', '.KKKKKKj.', '.kkkkkkj.', '.kkkkkkj.', '.jjjjjjj.'];
const HI_CATARMS = ['.g.g.....', 'gggggGg..', 'gEhgGGggh', 'wNwgggghh', '.wwhhh.g.'];
function heldTpl(rows, x, yBottom) { KEY = KEY_I; tpl(rows, x, yBottom - rows.length + 1); KEY = KEY_S; }
function heldItem(x, y) {
  switch (pose.item) {
    case ITEM_OPENBOX:                                               // itemF 1..3: popping open
      if (pose.itemF === 1) heldTpl(HI_FLAT, x - 4, y + 1); else heldTpl(pose.itemF === 2 ? HI_HALF : HI_OPEN, x - 3, y + 2);
      break;
    case ITEM_CATBOX: heldTpl(HI_CATBOX, x - 3, y + 2); break;
    case ITEM_CATARMS:
      heldTpl(HI_CATARMS, x - 4, y + 1);
      if (pose.scratch) { sp(x - 5 + pose.scratch, y + 1, C.SK0); sp(x - 4 + pose.scratch, y + 1, C.SK1); }   // fingers under the chin
      break;
    case ITEM_FLATBOX: heldTpl(HI_FLAT, x - 4, y + 1); break;
    case ITEM_MUG: rect(x - 1, y - 3, 3, 4, C.CREAM); sp(x + 2, y - 2, C.PAPSH); sp(x + 2, y - 1, C.CREAM); run(x - 1, y - 3, 3, C.WD1); break;
    case ITEM_STAMP: rect(x, y - 3, 2, 3, C.WD2); sp(x, y - 4, C.WD3); sp(x + 1, y - 4, C.WD3); run(x - 1, y, 4, C.DEEP); break;
  }
}
// Compose the sprite for the current pose into SPR (base view, facing screen-left).
function buildSorter() {
  KEY = KEY_S;
  sprClear();
  const back = pose.face === FACE_W || pose.face === FACE_N;
  const ox = AX - 7, top = AY - 26 + pose.bob + pose.bend + pose.squash;
  const hipY = AY - 9 + pose.bend;
  // legs (walk cycle: 0 contact L, 1 pass, 2 contact R, 3 pass)
  let fl = 0, fr = 0, fly = 0, fry = 0;
  if (pose.walk === 0) { fl = -2; fr = 2; fry = -1; } else if (pose.walk === 2) { fl = 1; fr = -1; fly = -1; }
  if (pose.bend) { fl -= 1; fr += 1; }
  leg(ox + 7, hipY - pose.bend, fr, fry, false, true);
  leg(ox + 4, hipY - pose.bend, fl, fly, true, true);
  // far arm (behind the torso)
  const shY = top + 11;
  arm(ox + 10, shY, ox + 10 + (pose.reach ? 1 : pose.armB), shY + (pose.reach ? -6 : 6), false);
  // torso + satchel
  tpl(back ? B_TORSO : A_TORSO, ox, top + 10);
  const bagX = back ? ox + 9 + pose.sway : ox + 0 + pose.sway;
  satchel(bagX, top + 15);
  // head
  tpl(back ? B_HEAD : A_HEAD, ox + (pose.tilt && !back ? -1 : 0), top);
  if (pose.look) { if (back) { sp(ox + 3, top + 4, C.SK1); } else { sp(ox + 4, top + 5, C.SK0); sp(ox + 4, top + 4, C.WD0); } }
  // near arm (in front), with pose variants
  let hx, hy;
  if (pose.reach) { hx = ox + 2; hy = shY - 7; }
  else if (pose.hold) { hx = ox + 1 - (pose.hold > 1 ? 1 : 0); hy = shY + (pose.hold === 4 ? -6 : pose.hold === 3 ? 0 : 3); }   // 4: raised high
  else { hx = ox + 2 + pose.armF; hy = shY + 6; }
  hy += pose.stamp;
  arm(ox + 2, shY, hx, hy, true);
  if (pose.item) heldItem(hx, hy + pose.itemY);
  outlineSprite();
}
// 4-neighbour outline; selective colour = 2 steps darker than the neighbour it hugs.
function outlineSprite() {
  for (let y = 0; y < SHT; y++) for (let x = 0; x < SW; x++) {
    const i = y * SW + x;
    if (SPR[i] !== EMPTY) continue;
    let n = EMPTY;
    if (x > 0 && SPR[i - 1] < OLF) n = SPR[i - 1];
    else if (x < SW - 1 && SPR[i + 1] < OLF) n = SPR[i + 1];
    else if (y > 0 && SPR[i - SW] < OLF) n = SPR[i - SW];
    else if (y < SHT - 1 && SPR[i + SW] < OLF) n = SPR[i + SW];
    if (n !== EMPTY) { SPR[i] = OLF; SPO[i] = SH[SH[n]]; }
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < SW * SHT; i++) if (SPR[i] === OLF) SPR[i] = 253;
}
// Billboard blit at world foot (fx, fy, fz). mirror = facing screen-right.
// blitClipZ: pixels below this world height are skipped (a box rising out of the hatch).
let blitClipZ = -1e9;
let blitClipSide=-1,blitClipAt=0; // Optional delivery plane; every ordinary sprite leaves it disabled.
let blitSurface=null; // Optional physical depth for a receding paper cat; ordinary sprites stay vertical.
function blitSprite(fx, fy, fz, mirror, sunOn) {
  const paper = paperCaptureSprite(fx, fy, fz, mirror, sunOn);
  const ax = Math.round(fx - fy) + tOX, ay = Math.round((fx + fy) * 0.5 - fz) + tOY;
  const d0 = (fx + fy + fz) * 4, surface=blitSurface;
  for (let y = 0; y < SHT; y++) {
    const py = ay + (y - AY);
    if (py < 0 || py >= tH) continue;
    const h = AY - y;
    for (let x = 0; x < SW; x++) {
      const c = SPR[y * SW + x];
      if (c === EMPTY) continue;
      const dx = mirror ? (AX - x) : (x - AX);
      const px = ax + dx;
      if (px < 0 || px >= tW) continue;
      const depth=surface?surface.depth[(y-surface.y)*surface.w+x-surface.x]:h*4;
      const i = py * tW + px, dep = Math.round(d0 + depth) + 2;
      if (dep < tDep[i]) continue;
      const sum=surface?(depth/4-h)/1.5:0;
      const wx=fx+(sum+dx)*.5,wy=fy+(sum-dx)*.5,wz=surface?fz+sum*.5+h:fz+h;
      if (wz < blitClipZ) continue;
      if(blitClipSide>=0&&(blitClipSide&1?wy:wx)*(blitClipSide<2?1:-1)>blitClipAt)continue;
      let lit = 0;
      if (sunOn) {
        const a = sunFn(wx, wy, wz, F_TOP);
        if (a > bayer(px + tPX, py + tPY)) {
          lit = 1;
          // rim: the pixel's screen-left neighbour is outside the silhouette
          const lx = mirror ? x + 1 : x - 1;
          const lc = (lx >= 0 && lx < SW) ? SPR[y * SW + lx] : EMPTY;
          if ((lc === EMPTY || lc === 253) && c !== 253) lit = 2;
        }
      }
      let lamp = lampFn !== null ? lampFn(wx, wy, wz, px + tPX, py + tPY, lit) : 0;
      tDep[i] = dep;
      if (c === 253) {                                     // outline pixel
        if (lit || lamp) { tIdx[i] = SPO[y * SW + x] | shBoard; tLvl[i] = 2; }
        else { tIdx[i] = C.OUT | shBoard; tLvl[i] = 2; }
      } else {
        tIdx[i] = c | shBoard; tLvl[i] = clamp(2 + lit + lamp, 0, 4);
      }
    }
  }
  paperFinishSprite(paper);
}
// ============================================================================
// 26 CATS: the Postmistress (a tuxedo cat in a post-blue cap with a brass badge)
// and the templates every loose cat shares (~12 x 8), side views facing
// screen-left (mirrored for screen-right). States: walk (4 frames), sit (head
// turns), stretch, curl. Her state comes from sim/14_world (WS.pm).
// ============================================================================
const CAT_WALK_BODY = [
  '.o..o........',
  '.ooooo......o',
  'oeoOoo.....o.',
  'nwOOoooooooo.',
  '.wwOOOOoood..',
  '..oooddooddo.',
];
const CAT_LEGS = [
  ['..w.o...o.w..', '..w.o...o.w..'],
  ['...wo....ow..', '...ww....ww..'],
  ['.w...o.o...w.', '.w...w.w...w.'],
  ['...ow....wo..', '...ww....ww..'],
];
const CAT_SIT = [
  '.o..o....',
  '.ooooo...',
  'oeoOoo...',
  'nwOOoo...',
  '.wwOooo..',
  '.wOooood.',
  '.wOooodd.',
  '.wwoooooo',
  '..ww.wwoo',
];
const CAT_SIT_HEAD_R = ['....o..o.', '...ooooo.', '...ooOoeo', '...ooOOwn'];
const CAT_SIT_HEAD_F = ['.o...o...', '.ooooo...', 'oeoOeo...', '.wnOw....'];
const CAT_STRETCH = [
  '...........o..',
  '.o..o.....oo..',
  '.oooo...oooo..',
  'oeoOo.ooooood.',
  'nwwOoooodoodd.',
  'wwwwoo....ww..',
];
const CAT_CURL = [
  '.d.d........',
  '.ooooOooo...',
  'oOzOoOOOood.',
  'owOoooddood.',
  '.wwoooooood.',
  '.ddddddddd..',
];
const CS_SLEEP = WORLD.CS.SLEEP, CS_STRETCH = WORLD.CS.STRETCH, CS_WALK = WORLD.CS.WALK, CS_SIT = WORLD.CS.SIT;
const cat = WS.pm;                                                    // x y z state frame face head flick
// Her cap, two rows above the ears row of a head at (x, y): side view (looking left or right) or front.
function capSide(x, y, right) {
  const x0 = right ? x + 3 : x, d = right ? -1 : 1;                   // column i of the cap is x0 + d * i
  sp(x0 + d, y - 2, C.BL2); sp(x0 + 2 * d, y - 2, C.BL2); sp(x0 + 3 * d, y - 2, C.BR3);   // crown and brass badge
  sp(x0, y - 1, C.BL1); for (let i = 1; i < 4; i++) sp(x0 + d * i, y - 1, C.BL2);         // peak, then the band
}
function capFront(x, y) {
  sp(x + 2, y - 2, C.BL2); sp(x + 3, y - 2, C.BR3); sp(x + 4, y - 2, C.BL2);
  sp(x + 1, y - 1, C.BL1); for (let i = 2; i < 5; i++) sp(x + i, y - 1, C.BL2); sp(x + 5, y - 1, C.BL1);
}
function buildCat() {
  KEY = KEY_TUX;
  sprClear();
  switch (cat.state) {
    case CS_WALK: {
      const x0 = AX - 6, y0 = AY - 7 + (cat.frame & 1 ? -1 : 0) + 1;
      tpl(CAT_WALK_BODY, x0, y0);
      tpl(CAT_LEGS[cat.frame & 3], x0, AY - 1);
      capSide(x0, y0, false);
      break;
    }
    case CS_SIT: {
      const x0 = AX - 4, y0 = AY - 8;
      tpl(CAT_SIT, x0, y0);
      if (cat.head === 1) { rect(x0, y0, 9, 4, EMPTY); tpl(CAT_SIT_HEAD_R, x0, y0); capSide(x0 + 5, y0, true); }
      else if (cat.head === 2) { rect(x0, y0, 9, 4, EMPTY); tpl(CAT_SIT_HEAD_F, x0, y0); capFront(x0, y0); }
      else capSide(x0, y0, false);
      if (cat.flick) sp(x0 + 8, y0 + 6, C.DEEP);
      break;
    }
    case CS_STRETCH: tpl(CAT_STRETCH, AX - 7, AY - 5); capSide(AX - 7, AY - 4, false); break;
    default: {
      const x0 = AX - 6, y0 = AY - 5;
      tpl(CAT_CURL, x0, y0);
      capSide(x0, y0, false);
      if (cat.flick) { sp(x0 + 1, y0 + 5, EMPTY); sp(x0, y0 + 4, C.OUT); } else sp(x0, y0 + 5, C.DEEP);
      break;
    }
  }
  KEY = KEY_S;
  outlineSprite();
}
function drawCat() {
  buildCat();
  blitSprite(cat.x, cat.y, cat.z, cat.face === 1, true);
}
// The conveyor's rider once it hops off (WS.walker): follows the sorter up the corridor, hops onto
// the plinth ledge, steps into the cubby the sorter emptied and curls up there as a cubby sleeper.
const WALKER_POSE = ['curl', 'stretch', 'walk', 'sit'];              // by CS_*
function drawWalker() {
  const wk = WS.walker, c = SCN.cubbies.collect;
  if (!wk.on) return;
  shSunMax = 1; shFlag = 0; shBias = 0;
  if (wk.state === CS_SLEEP) { drawCubbyCat(c[0], c[1], 'sleep', COAT_GINGER, 0.7, loopT); return; }   // the sleeper the cubby keeps drawing
  buildLoose(COAT_GINGER, WALKER_POSE[wk.state], wk.frame, 0);
  blitSprite(wk.x, wk.y, wk.z, wk.face === 1, true);
}

// ---- cats in the cubby beds (scene.json cubbies) ---------------------------------------------
// Small enough for an 8 x 9 cubby. Sleepers breathe every 3 s and twitch an ear every 8 s;
// peekers blink every 4 s and glance left or right every 12 s (all divide the 48 s loop).
const CUB_SLEEP = [['.o.o...', 'oooooO.', 'ozoooOd', 'wwooodd'], ['.o.o....', 'ooooOo..', 'ozoOoood', 'wwoooodd']];
const CUB_PEEK = ['o...o', 'oo.oo', 'oeoeo', 'ooOoo', '.wnw.'], CUB_PEEK_BLINK = ['o...o', 'oo.oo', 'ododo', 'ooOoo', '.wnw.'];
function drawCubbyCat(cx, rz, kind, coat, phase, t) {
  const x = BANK_X0 + cx * CUB_W + 4, z = BANK_Z0 + rz * CUB_H + 0.5 + 1.3, tt = t + phase;
  KEY = coatKeyOf(coat);
  sprClear();
  if (kind === 'sleep') {
    const rows = CUB_SLEEP[(cx + rz) & 1], top = AY - rows.length + 1;
    tpl(rows, AX - 3, top);
    if (fract(tt / 3) < 0.4) sp(AX + 1, top - 1, KEY[79]);                  // breath in: the back rises ('O')
    if (Math.floor(fract(tt / 8) * 80) === 40) sp(AX - 2, top, EMPTY);      // ear twitch
    KEY = KEY_S; outlineSprite();
    blitSprite(x, 11.6, z, ((cx * 7 + rz) & 1) === 1, true);          // anchored on the cushion's front edge
  } else {
    const blink = Math.floor(fract(tt / 4) * 40) === 0, g = fract(tt / 12), look = g < 0.1 ? -1 : g > 0.5 && g < 0.6 ? 1 : 0;
    tpl(blink ? CUB_PEEK_BLINK : CUB_PEEK, AX - 2 + look, AY - 4);
    KEY = KEY_S; outlineSprite();
    blitSprite(x, 12, z, false, true);                                  // chin on the cubby's lip
  }
}
function drawCubbyCats(t, collectHome) {
  const list = SCN.cubbies.cats;
  shSunMax = 1; shFlag = 0; shBias = 0;
  for (let k = 0; k < list.length; k++) drawCubbyCat(list[k][0], list[k][1], list[k][2], list[k][3] === 'ginger' ? COAT_GINGER : COAT_BLUE, list[k][4], t);
  if (collectHome) { const c = SCN.cubbies.collect; drawCubbyCat(c[0], c[1], 'sleep', COAT_GINGER, 0.7, t); }
  drawCarrierEyes(t);
}
// ============================================================================
// 27 CATS IN BOXES + LOOSE CATS. Composed into the sprite buffer each frame and
// blitted with depth, sun, rim and lamp light (25_sprites).
//  - the box is drawn procedurally so its lighting never flips: left face lit,
//    right face in shade, flaps folded out; only the cat is mirrored
//  - two views: towards (faces screen-left-down = S; mirrored = E) and away
//    (faces screen-left-up = W; mirrored = N); the head faces the travel direction
//  - head at the leading side, tail at the trailing side, so tail to head points
//    the way the cat is going: towards, the face over the front rim and the tail
//    up behind; away, the back of the head over the far rim and the tail hanging
//    over the front rim (outlined, so it reads against the box)
//  - ginger: orange tabby, darker head stripes, white chin, green eyes;
//    blue: solid slate, no stripes, pale gold eyes (the second cue in grayscale)
//  - out of the box (arrive, nap, leave, puzzled) the cats reuse the office cat's
//    walk / sit / stretch / curl templates (26_cats) in their own coat
// ============================================================================
const COAT_GINGER = 1, COAT_BLUE = 2, COAT_TUX = 3;
const KEY_GIN = new Uint8Array(128), KEY_BLU = new Uint8Array(128), KEY_TUX = new Uint8Array(128);
function coatKey(K, o, O, d, s, w, e, n, i) {
  KEY = K;
  defKey('o', o); defKey('O', O); defKey('d', d); defKey('s', s); defKey('w', w); defKey('e', e); defKey('n', n);
  defKey('i', i); defKey('k', C.OUT); defKey('z', C.OUT); defKey('W', C.CREAM); defKey('m', C.WD0);
  KEY = KEY_S;
}
coatKey(KEY_GIN, C.CT1, C.CT2, C.CT0, C.CT0, C.WHITE, C.PT2, C.RD4, C.SK0);
coatKey(KEY_BLU, C.BC1, C.BC2, C.BC0, C.BC1, C.BC2, C.BR3, C.BC0, C.SK1);   // 's' stripes vanish into the coat
coatKey(KEY_TUX, C.DEEP, C.COOL1, C.OUT, C.DEEP, C.WHITE, C.BR3, C.RD4, C.SK1);
// Blue heads sit a step lighter than the body so the face and gold eyes read in the box.
const KEY_BLU_HEAD = new Uint8Array(128);
coatKey(KEY_BLU_HEAD, C.BC2, C.BC3, C.BC1, C.BC2, C.BC3, C.BR3, C.BC0, C.SK1);
function coatKeyOf(coat) { return coat === COAT_BLUE ? KEY_BLU : coat === COAT_TUX ? KEY_TUX : KEY_GIN; }
function coatOf(k) { return k === COAT_BLUE ? 'blue' : 'ginger'; }

// ---- parts (positions are relative to the box's footprint centre) --------------------------
const CB_HEAD_A = {
  open:   ['o....o.', 'oi..io.', 'ossooso', 'oekoekO', 'ooOnOoo', '.owwwo.'],
  blink:  ['o....o.', 'oi..io.', 'ossooso', 'oddoddO', 'ooOnOoo', '.owwwo.'],
  twitch: ['.....o.', 'ooi.io.', 'ossooso', 'oekoekO', 'ooOnOoo', '.owwwo.'],
  back:   ['.......', 'oo...oo', 'ossooso', 'oekoekO', 'ooOnOoo', '.owwwo.'],   // ears flat: surprised
  yawn:   ['o....o.', 'oi..io.', 'ossooso', 'oddoddO', 'ooOkOoo', '.owkwo.'],
};
const CB_HEAD_B = {
  open:   ['o...o.', 'oo.oo.', 'oosooo', 'ooosoo', '.oooo.'],
  twitch: ['....o.', 'ooooo.', 'oosooo', 'ooosoo', '.oooo.'],
  back:   ['......', 'oo..oo', 'oosooo', 'ooosoo', '.oooo.'],
};
const CB_CHEST_A = ['oOwOo', '.ooo.'], CB_PAWS_A = [-6, -5, -3, -2], CB_TAIL_A = ['.oo', 'o..', 'o..', '.o.', '.o.', '.o.'];
const CB_NECK_B = ['oooo', 'oooo'], CB_PAWS_B = ['O...O'], CB_TAIL_B = ['kook', '.kok', '.kok', '.kok', '.kOk', '..k.'];
let cbKey = KEY_GIN, cbMirror = false, cbBX = 0, cbBY = 0;
function cbPut(x, y, c) { sp(cbMirror ? 2 * cbBX - x - 1 : x, y, c); }     // cat pixels mirror round the box centre
function cbTpl(rows, dx, dy) {
  for (let j = 0; j < rows.length; j++) {
    const r = rows[j];
    for (let i = 0; i < r.length; i++) { const ch = r.charCodeAt(i); if (ch !== 46) cbPut(cbBX + dx + i, cbBY + dy + j, cbKey[ch]); }
  }
}
// Box: columns -8..7 around the footprint centre; a = distance from the middle column pair.
function boxRow(x) { const a = x < 0 ? -x - 1 : x; return a; }
function drawBoxBack(bx, by) {
  for (let x = -8; x < 8; x++) {
    const a = boxRow(x), yu = -9 + (a >> 1), yl = -1 - (a >> 1);
    sp(bx + x, by + yu, C.KRAFT2);                                   // far rim
    for (let y = yu + 1; y < yl; y++) sp(bx + x, by + y, y <= yu + 2 ? C.WD1 : C.DEEP);   // far walls, then floor
    if (a >= 1 && a <= 6) sp(bx + x, by + yu - 1, x < 0 ? C.KRAFT2 : C.KRAFT);           // far flaps stand up
    if (a >= 2 && a <= 5) sp(bx + x, by + yu - 2, x < 0 ? C.KRAFT2 : C.KRAFT);
  }
}
function drawBoxFront(bx, by, fold) {                                // fold: 0 open, 1..3 folding, 4 flat
  const up = fold <= 0 ? 0 : fold === 1 ? 1 : fold === 2 ? 3 : 4;      // walls sink as it folds
  for (let x = -8; x < 8; x++) {
    const a = boxRow(x), yl = -1 - (a >> 1) + up, yf = 4 - (a >> 1), left = x < 0;
    for (let y = yl; y <= yf; y++) {
      let c = left ? C.KRAFT : C.KRAFT0;
      if (y === yl) c = left ? C.KRAFT2 : C.KRAFT;                   // front rim catches the light
      else if (y === yl + 1 && a <= 6 && fold <= 0) c = left ? C.KRAFT2 : C.KRAFT;   // front flaps hang over the faces
      if (y === yf) c = left ? C.KRAFT0 : C.WD1;                     // foot
      sp(bx + x, by + y, c);
    }
  }
}
function drawTag(bx, by, red, mirror) {                              // address tag on a string, away from the head
  const tx = mirror ? bx - 10 : bx + 8, c = red ? C.RD2 : C.BL2, c2 = red ? C.RD1 : C.BL1;
  sp(tx, by - 5, C.CREAM); sp(tx, by - 4, C.CREAM);
  sp(tx, by - 3, c); sp(tx + 1, by - 3, c); sp(tx, by - 2, c); sp(tx + 1, by - 2, c); sp(tx, by - 1, c2); sp(tx + 1, by - 1, c2);
}
function fillBody(bx, by, view, stripes, bob) {                      // the cat filling the opening
  for (let x = -8; x < 8; x++) {
    const mx = cbMirror ? -x - 1 : x;
    if (mx < (view === 0 ? -3 : -6)) continue;
    const a = boxRow(x), yu = -9 + (a >> 1), yl = -1 - (a >> 1);
    for (let y = yu + 1 - bob; y < yl; y++) {
      let c = cbKey[111];                                            // 'o'
      if (y === yu + 1 - bob) c = cbKey[79];                         // 'O': light along the back
      else if (stripes && ((mx + (y - yu)) & 3) === 0) c = cbKey[115];   // 's': tabby stripes
      if (y === yl - 1 && view === 0) c = cbKey[100];                // 'd'
      sp(bx + x, by + y, c);
    }
  }
}
// dir: travel direction (0 E, 1 S, 2 W, 3 N); head: where the head looks (leads a turn by a frame)
function buildCatBox(coat, dir, head, ears, eyes, bob, stretch, red) { catBoxPixels(coat, dir, head, ears, eyes, bob, stretch, red); outlineSprite(); }
function catBoxPixels(coat, dir, head, ears, eyes, bob, stretch, red) {   // without the outline, for extras drawn on top
  sprClear();
  cbKey = coatKeyOf(coat);
  const bx = AX, by = AY - 4;
  cbBX = bx; cbBY = by;
  const view = (dir === 1 || dir === 0) ? 0 : 1;                     // 0 towards (S, E), 1 away (W, N)
  const hv = (head === 1 || head === 0) ? 0 : 1, hm = head === 0 || head === 3;
  cbMirror = dir === 0 || dir === 3;
  drawBoxBack(bx, by);
  const b = bob ? 1 : 0, st = stretch | 0;
  fillBody(bx, by, view, coat === COAT_GINGER, b);
  if (view === 0) cbTpl(CB_TAIL_A, 3, -14 - b);
  // the head (drawn in the head's own view; on a turn it gets there a frame early)
  if (coat === COAT_BLUE) cbKey = KEY_BLU_HEAD;
  cbMirror = hm;
  if (hv === 1) {
    cbTpl(CB_NECK_B, -6, -9 - b);
    cbTpl(ears === 2 ? CB_HEAD_B.back : ears === 1 ? CB_HEAD_B.twitch : CB_HEAD_B.open, -7, -14 - b - st);
    cbTpl(CB_PAWS_B, -7, -8);
  }
  cbMirror = dir === 0 || dir === 3;
  cbKey = coatKeyOf(coat);
  drawBoxFront(bx, by, 0);
  if (view === 1) cbTpl(CB_TAIL_B, 2, -3);
  if (coat === COAT_BLUE) cbKey = KEY_BLU_HEAD;
  cbMirror = hm;
  if (hv === 0) {
    const h = ears === 2 ? CB_HEAD_A.back : eyes === 2 ? CB_HEAD_A.yawn : eyes ? CB_HEAD_A.blink : ears === 1 ? CB_HEAD_A.twitch : CB_HEAD_A.open;
    cbTpl(h, -7, -9 - b - st);
    if (st) cbTpl(CB_CHEST_A, -6, -3 - st);
    for (const x of CB_PAWS_A) cbPut(bx + x, by - 1 - (boxRow(x) >> 1) - (st > 1 ? 1 : 0), cbKey[79]);   // 'O' on the front rim
  }
  cbMirror = false;
  drawTag(bx, by, red, dir === 0 || dir === 3);
}
// An empty box on its own: open, folding (1..3) or flat (4).
function buildBox(fold, red, mirror) {
  sprClear();
  const bx = AX, by = AY - 4;
  if (fold < 4) drawBoxBack(bx, by + (fold >= 2 ? 3 : 0));
  if (fold < 4) drawBoxFront(bx, by, fold);
  else for (let x = -9; x < 9; x++) {                                // flat-packed: a thin slab
    const a = x < 0 ? -x - 1 : x, yt = -1 - (a >> 1) + 3, yb = yt + 1 + (a < 8 ? 1 : 0);
    for (let y = yt; y <= yb; y++) sp(bx + x, by + y, y === yt ? C.KRAFT2 : x < 0 ? C.KRAFT : C.KRAFT0);
  }
  if (fold < 3) drawTag(bx, by, red, mirror);
  outlineSprite();
}

// ---- loose cats (office-cat templates in any coat) --------------------------------------------
const CAT_SIT_YAWN = ['.o..o....', '.ooooo...', 'ozozoo...', 'nwkwoo...'];
function buildLoose(coat, pose, frame, look) {
  KEY = coatKeyOf(coat);
  sprClear();
  switch (pose) {
    case 'walk': {
      const x0 = AX - 6, y0 = AY - 7;
      tpl(CAT_WALK_BODY, x0, y0 + ((frame & 1) ? -1 : 0) + 1);
      tpl(CAT_LEGS[frame & 3], x0, y0 + 6);
      break;
    }
    case 'stretch': tpl(CAT_STRETCH, AX - 7, AY - 5); break;
    case 'sit': case 'sitfront': case 'sitright': case 'yawn': {
      const x0 = AX - 4, y0 = AY - 8;
      tpl(CAT_SIT, x0, y0);
      if (pose !== 'sit') rect(x0, y0, 9, 4, EMPTY);
      if (pose === 'sitfront') tpl(CAT_SIT_HEAD_F, x0, y0);
      else if (pose === 'sitright') tpl(CAT_SIT_HEAD_R, x0, y0);
      else if (pose === 'yawn') tpl(CAT_SIT_YAWN, x0, y0);
      if (look === 1) sp(x0 + 8, y0 + 6, KEY[111]);                   // tail flick
      else if (look === 2) { sp(x0 + 8, y0 + 5, KEY[111]); sp(x0 + 8, y0 + 7, EMPTY); }
      break;
    }
    default: {                                                        // curled up asleep
      const x0 = AX - 6, y0 = AY - 5;
      tpl(CAT_CURL, x0, y0 - (frame & 1));
      if (frame & 1) for (let x = x0 + 1; x < x0 + 11; x++) if (SPR[(y0 + 5) * SW + x] === EMPTY && SPR[(y0 + 4) * SW + x] !== EMPTY) sp(x, y0 + 5, KEY[100]);
      break;
    }
  }
  KEY = KEY_S;
  outlineSprite();
}
// "?" over a puzzled cat: 3 x 5 px, white with the usual outline (drawn as its own sprite).
const QMARK = ['WWW', '..W', '.WW', '...', '.W.'];
function drawQMark(x, y, z, bob) {
  sprClear(); KEY = KEY_GIN; tpl(QMARK, AX - 1, AY - 4 - bob); KEY = KEY_S; outlineSprite();
  blitSprite(x, y, z, false, false);
}

// ---- drawing a board cat from its pose (12_boardanim) --------------------------------------
const BA = BOARDANIM.A;
function drawBoardCat(o, tr) {
  if(paperEnabled&&tr.big&&drawPaperBigCat(o,tr))return;
  if(paperEnabled&&o.flapPose>=0&&drawPaperFlapCat(o,tr))return;
  if(paperEnabled&&o.takeoff>=0&&drawPaperTakeoff(o,tr))return;
  const coat = tr.coat, red = coat === COAT_GINGER, px = o.x, py = o.y;
  shSunMax = 1; shFlag = 0; shBias = 0;
  switch (o.anim) {
    case BA.HIDDEN: return;
    case BA.POP: case BA.TRAVEL: case BA.BOUNCE: case BA.STOP: case BA.STUCK: case BA.IDLE: case BA.STRETCH: {
      const st = o.anim === BA.STRETCH ? Math.min(2, o.frame + 1) : 0;
      buildCatBox(coat, o.dir, o.head, o.ears, o.eyes, o.bob, st, red);
      if (o.anim === BA.POP || (o.tunnelPair >= 0 && o.z < 0)) blitClipZ = 0;
      blitSprite(px + 4, py + 4, o.z, false, true);
      blitClipZ = -1e9;
      if (o.flapWrong) drawQMark(px, py, o.z + 11, Math.floor(loopT * 2) & 1);
      return;
    }
    case BA.HOP: buildLoose(coat, 'stretch', 0, 0); break;
    case BA.TURN: buildLoose(coat, o.frame === 1 ? 'sitfront' : 'sit', 0, 0); break;
    case BA.CURL: buildLoose(coat, o.frame < 2 ? 'sit' : 'curl', 0, 0); break;
    case BA.NAP: buildLoose(coat, 'curl', o.frame, 0); break;
    case BA.WAKE: buildLoose(coat, o.frame < 2 ? 'yawn' : 'stretch', 0, 0); break;
    case BA.LEAVE: buildLoose(coat, 'walk', o.frame, 0); break;
    case BA.PUZZLED: buildLoose(coat, 'sitfront', 0, o.frame); break;
  }
  const faceRight = o.dir === 0 || o.dir === 3 || (o.anim === BA.TURN && (o.frame & 1));
  blitSprite(px, py, o.z, faceRight, true);
  if (o.anim === BA.PUZZLED) drawQMark(px, py, o.z + 11, Math.floor(loopT * 2) & 1);
}
function drawBoardBox(o, tr) {
  if(paperEnabled&&tr.big&&drawPaperBigBox(o,tr))return;
  if(paperEnabled&&tr.homeKind==='flap'){drawPaperFlapBox(o,tr);return;}                                       // the emptied box after a cat hops out
  if (o.boxFold < 0) return;
  buildBox(o.boxFold, tr.coat === COAT_GINGER, false);
  if (o.boxFade > 0) {                                               // dithered fade as it slides away
    const f = o.boxFade;
    for (let y = 0; y < SHT; y++) for (let x = 0; x < SW; x++) if (bayer(x, y) < f) SPR[y * SW + x] = EMPTY;
  }
  shSunMax = 1;
  blitSprite(o.boxX + 4, o.boxY + 4, 0, false, true);
}
// Waiting cats as tiny heads on the hatch lid, the next one out nearest the way out.
const QUEUE_HEAD = ['o...o', 'ooooo', 'oeoeo', '.ooo.'];
function drawHatchQueue(x0, y0, dir, coats, n) {
  for (let k = n - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
    const along = 3 - k * 4, cx = x0 + 8 + DXS[dir] * along, cy = y0 + 8 + DYS[dir] * along;
    KEY = coatKeyOf(coats[k]); sprClear(); tpl(QUEUE_HEAD, AX - 2, AY - 3); KEY = KEY_S; outlineSprite();
    shSunMax = 1;
    blitSprite(Math.round(cx), Math.round(cy), 0.5, false, true);
  }
}
// Supported paper take-off. The rules trace and its turn/curl/nap/leave clock
// remain authoritative; this pass changes only the rendered arrival positions.
const TAKEOFF_DX=[1,0,-1,0],TAKEOFF_DY=[0,1,0,-1];
const TAKEOFF_STOP=14,TAKEOFF_CROUCH=.2,TAKEOFF_PUSH=.3,TAKEOFF_CLEAR=.4;
const TAKEOFF_FOLD=.45,TAKEOFF_FLAT=.75,TAKEOFF_GONE=1.2,TAKEOFF_LAND=.6;
const takeoffQ=v=>Math.round(v*2)/2;
const takeoffEase=v=>{v=clamp(v,0,1);return v*v*(3-2*v);};
function makeBoardCatPose(){
  const o=BOARDANIM.makeOut();o.takeoff=-1;o.takeoffSupported=0;o.flapPose=-1;o.flapRim=0;o.flapBack=0;o.flapClipSide=-1;o.flapClipAt=0;return o;
}
function buildPaperTakeoff(coat,dir,frame){
  const away=dir===2||dir===3,k=((coat-1)*2+(away?1:0))*4+frame;
  const source=paperTakeoffSources[k];
  if(!source||coat<1||coat>2||frame<0||frame>3)return false;
  SPR.set(source);SPO.fill(0);return true;
}
function paperBoardArrivalPose(o,tr,now){
  o.takeoff=-1;o.takeoffSupported=0;
  paperBoardFlapPose(o,tr,now);
  if(tr.homeKind==='flap'){if(paperEnabled&&tr.big&&paperBigSources[0])paperBigFlapPose(o,tr,now);return;}
  if(paperEnabled&&tr.big&&paperBigSources[0]){paperBigArrivalPose(o,tr,now);return;}
  if(!paperEnabled||!paperTakeoffSources[0]||tr.n===0||tr.coat<1||tr.coat>2||
      (tr.end!==BOARDANIM.END_HOME&&tr.end!==BOARDANIM.END_WRONG))return;
  const j=tr.n-1,d=tr.d0[j],T=now-(tr.rel+tr.n*tr.tick);
  const hx=tr.ox+tr.x1[j]*TILE+8,hy=tr.oy+tr.y1[j]*TILE+8;
  const bx=hx-TAKEOFF_DX[d]*TAKEOFF_STOP,by=hy-TAKEOFF_DY[d]*TAKEOFF_STOP;
  if(T<0){
    if(T<-tr.tick||tr.bn[j]||o.anim===BA.HIDDEN||o.anim===BA.POP)return;
    // Meet the parked box from its actual incoming tile, without a terminal jump.
    const u=takeoffEase((T+tr.tick)/(tr.tick*.6));
    o.x=takeoffQ(lerp(tr.ox+tr.x0[j]*TILE+8,bx,u));
    o.y=takeoffQ(lerp(tr.oy+tr.y0[j]*TILE+8,by,u));return;
  }
  const wrong=tr.end===BOARDANIM.END_WRONG;
  if(!wrong&&now>=tr.napUntil){
    if(o.anim===BA.WAKE)o.z=3;
    else if(o.anim===BA.LEAVE)o.z+=Math.round(3*(1-clamp((now-tr.napUntil-BOARDANIM.WAKE_LEN)/BOARDANIM.LEAVE_LEN,0,1)));
    return;
  }
  if(T<TAKEOFF_CROUCH){o.x=bx;o.y=by;return;}
  const fade=wrong?0:clamp((T-TAKEOFF_FLAT)/(TAKEOFF_GONE-TAKEOFF_FLAT),0,1),slide=takeoffEase(fade);
  o.boxX=takeoffQ(bx-Math.SQRT1_2*12*slide);o.boxY=takeoffQ(by+Math.SQRT1_2*12*slide);
  o.boxFade=fade;
  o.boxFold=wrong||T<TAKEOFF_FOLD?0:T<TAKEOFF_FLAT?1+Math.floor((T-TAKEOFF_FOLD)*10+1e-6):T<TAKEOFF_GONE?4:-1;
  if(T>=TAKEOFF_LAND){if(!wrong)o.z=3;return;}
  const mirrored=d===0||d===3,away=d===2||d===3,sx=mirrored?-2:2;
  const u=clamp((T-TAKEOFF_CLEAR)/(TAKEOFF_LAND-TAKEOFF_CLEAR),0,1);
  const tx=wrong?Math.round((hx+3)*.5)*2:Math.round((hx+tr.homeDX)*.5)*2;
  const ty=wrong?Math.round((hy+3)*.5)*2:Math.round((hy+tr.homeDY)*.5)*2;
  const startZ=away?-1:5,endZ=wrong?1:-1;
  o.x=takeoffQ(lerp(bx+4+sx,tx+(mirrored?-3:3),u));
  o.y=takeoffQ(lerp(by+4-sx,ty+(mirrored?3:-3),u));
  o.z=T<TAKEOFF_CLEAR?startZ:Math.round(lerp(startZ,endZ,u)+Math.sin(u*Math.PI)*3+(1-u)**4);
  o.takeoff=T<TAKEOFF_PUSH?0:T<TAKEOFF_CLEAR?1:T<TAKEOFF_FOLD?2:3;
  o.takeoffSupported=T<TAKEOFF_CLEAR?1:0;
}
function drawPaperTakeoff(o,tr){
  if(!paperTakeoffSources[0])return false;
  drawBoardBox(o,tr);
  buildPaperTakeoff(tr.coat,o.dir,o.takeoff);
  shSunMax=1;shFlag=0;shBias=0;
  blitSprite(o.x,o.y,o.z,o.dir===0||o.dir===3,true);
  if(o.takeoffSupported){
    SPR.set(paperTakeoffSources[15+tr.coat]);SPO.fill(0);
    blitSprite(o.boxX+4,o.boxY+4,0,false,true);
  }
  return true;
}
// Separate flap presentation: rooted support, low passage and a delayed empty-box fold.
// Rule events/ticks remain authoritative. Angles and times are immutable scene data.
function paperBoardFlapPose(o,tr,now){
  o.flapPose=-1;o.flapRim=0;o.flapBack=0;o.flapClipSide=-1;o.flapClipAt=0;
  if(tr.homeKind!=='flap'||tr.n===0)return;
  const A=EDGE_PORTAL_DATA.arrival,j=tr.n-1,d=tr.homeSide,T=now-(tr.rel+tr.n*tr.tick);
  const hx=tr.ox+tr.x1[j]*TILE+8,hy=tr.oy+tr.y1[j]*TILE+8;
  const plane=8+(d<2?EDGE_PORTAL_DATA.outset+EDGE_PORTAL_DATA.housingDepth:EDGE_PORTAL_DATA.backOutset);
  const wrong=tr.end===BOARDANIM.END_WRONG,stop=wrong?0:plane-(d>=2?A.awayStopGap:A.stopGap)-(tr.big?2:0);
  const bx=hx+TAKEOFF_DX[d]*stop,by=hy+TAKEOFF_DY[d]*stop;
  if(T<0){
    if(T<-tr.tick||o.anim===BA.HIDDEN||o.anim===BA.POP)return;
    const f=clamp((T+tr.tick)/tr.tick,0,1),bounced=tr.bn[j];
    const p=bounced?(f<.35?-2*takeoffEase(f/.35):lerp(-2,stop,takeoffEase((f-.35)/.65))):stop*takeoffEase(f/.8);
    o.x=takeoffQ(hx+TAKEOFF_DX[d]*p);o.y=takeoffQ(hy+TAKEOFF_DY[d]*p);
    o.dir=o.head=bounced&&f<.35?tr.d0[j]:d;o.z=0;o.bob=0;return;
  }
  o.dir=o.head=d;o.z=0;o.bob=0;o.flapOpen=0;o.takeoff=-1;o.flapWrong=wrong;
  if(wrong){
    o.anim=BA.IDLE;o.x=hx;o.y=hy;o.boxFold=-1;
    const face=Math.floor(T*2)%3;o.eyes=face===1?1:0;o.ears=face===2?BOARDANIM.EARS_TWITCH:0;return;
  }
  o.boxX=bx;o.boxY=by;o.boxFade=0;
  o.boxFold=T<A.fold?0:T<A.flat?1+Math.floor((T-A.fold)*10+1e-6):T<A.gone?4:-1;
  if(T>=A.flat){
    const fade=clamp((T-A.flat)/(A.gone-A.flat),0,1),slide=takeoffEase(fade);
    o.boxX=takeoffQ(bx-Math.SQRT1_2*12*slide);o.boxY=takeoffQ(by+Math.SQRT1_2*12*slide);o.boxFade=fade;
  }
  if(T>=A.clear){o.anim=BA.HIDDEN;o.x=bx;o.y=by;return;}
  const posesAt=d>=2?A.awayPosesAt:A.posesAt;
  let pose=0;for(let k=1;k<posesAt.length;k++)if(T>=posesAt[k])pose=k;
  o.flapPose=pose;o.flapRim=T<.65?1:0;
  o.flapBack=d>=2?2*(1-takeoffEase(T/A.contact)):2*(1-takeoffEase((T-.36)/.12));o.anim=BA.TRAVEL;
  const p=takeoffEase((T-A.contact)/(A.clear-A.contact))*(d>=2?A.awayTravel:10);
  o.x=takeoffQ(bx+TAKEOFF_DX[d]*p);o.y=takeoffQ(by+TAKEOFF_DY[d]*p);
  o.flapClipSide=d;o.flapClipAt=(d&1?hy:hx)*(d<2?1:-1)+plane;
}
function paperFlapDoorState(src,f){
  const A=EDGE_PORTAL_DATA.arrival;let active=0,latest=Infinity;
  for(let i=0;i<src.n;i++){
    const tr=src.traces[i],now=src.times[i];
    if(!tr||now<0||tr.homeKind!=='flap'||tr.end!==BOARDANIM.END_HOME||tr.homeSide!==f.side||tr.coat!==f.coat||!tr.n)continue;
    const j=tr.n-1;if(tr.x1[j]!==f.x||tr.y1[j]!==f.y)continue;
    const T=now-(tr.rel+tr.n*tr.tick);if(T<A.contact)continue;
    latest=Math.min(latest,T);
    if(T<A.clear)active=Math.max(active,T<.56?1:T<.68?2:3);
  }
  if(active)return active;
  let state=0;for(let k=0;k<A.doorTimes.length;k++)if(latest>=A.doorTimes[k])state=A.doorStates[k];
  return latest===Infinity?0:state;
}
function buildPaperFlapCat(coat,dir,frame){
  const k=((coat-1)*2+(dir>=2?1:0))*8+frame,source=paperFlapSources[k];
  if(coat<1||coat>2||frame<0||frame>=8||!source)return false;
  SPR.set(source);SPO.fill(0);return true;
}
function drawPaperFlapCat(o,tr){
  if(!buildPaperFlapCat(tr.coat,o.dir,o.flapPose))return false;
  if(o.dir>=2)return drawPaperFlapEntry(o,tr);
  drawPaperFlapBox(o,tr);buildPaperFlapCat(tr.coat,o.dir,o.flapPose);
  shSunMax=1;shFlag=0;shBias=0;
  blitSurface=o.dir>=2?paperLookup.get(paperSpriteHash()):null;
  blitClipSide=o.flapClipSide;blitClipAt=o.flapClipAt;
  const x=o.x-TAKEOFF_DX[o.dir]*o.flapBack,y=o.y-TAKEOFF_DY[o.dir]*o.flapBack;
  const sx=Math.round(x-y),sy=Math.round((x+y)*.5);
  blitSprite(sy+sx*.5,sy-sx*.5,0,o.dir===0||o.dir===3,true);
  blitClipSide=-1;blitClipAt=0;blitSurface=null;
  return true;
}

// Authored away poses are progressively occluded at one real doorway anchor.
// Keeping the mouth fixed prevents a world-plane clip from erasing a cat beside it.
function drawPaperFlapEntry(o,tr){
  drawPaperFlapBox(o,tr);buildPaperFlapCat(tr.coat,o.dir,o.flapPose);
  const r=paperLookup.get(paperSpriteHash()),j=tr.n-1,d=o.dir,mirror=d===3;
  const hx=tr.ox+tr.x1[j]*TILE+8,hy=tr.oy+tr.y1[j]*TILE+8,p=8+EDGE_PORTAL_DATA.backOutset;
  const x=d===2?hx-p+o.flapBack:hx+r.entryMouth[0],y=d===3?hy-p+o.flapBack:hy-r.entryMouth[0];
  const ex=mirror?AX-r.entryNative[0]/4+.75:r.entryNative[0]/4-AX,ey=r.entryNative[1]/4-AY;
  const sx=Math.round(x-y-ex),sy=Math.round((x+y)*.5-r.entryMouth[1]-ey);
  shSunMax=1;shFlag=0;shBias=0;blitSurface=r;blitClipSide=-1;blitClipAt=0;
  blitSprite(sy+sx*.5,sy-sx*.5,0,mirror,true);
  blitSurface=null;return true;
}

function drawPaperFlapBox(o,tr){
  if(o.boxFold<0)return;
  drawPaperPhysicalPiece(7,(tr.coat===COAT_BLUE?5:0)+o.boxFold,o.boxX,o.boxY,o.boxFade);
}
// Original full-size paper cats. Source buffers are installed once; draws only copy
// into the existing32x36 sprite workspace. Normal cats keep their accepted paths.
function buildPaperBig(index){
  const source=paperBigSources[index];if(!source)return false;
  SPR.set(source);SPO.fill(0);return true;
}
function paperBigSlot(coat,dir){return ((coat-1)*2+(dir>=2?1:0))*35;}
function paperBigCatIndex(o,tr){
  const base=paperBigSlot(tr.coat,o.dir);
  if(o.flapPose>=0)return base+27+o.flapPose;
  if(o.takeoff>=0)return base+14+(o.takeoff<2?o.takeoff:2);
  switch(o.anim){
    case BA.HIDDEN:return -1;
    case BA.HOP:return base+16;
    case BA.TURN:return base+17;
    case BA.CURL:return base+(o.frame<2?18:19);
    case BA.NAP:return base+19+(o.frame&1);
    case BA.WAKE:return base+(o.frame<2?21:14);
    case BA.LEAVE:return base+22+(o.frame&3);
    case BA.PUZZLED:return base+26;
    default:{
      const face=o.flapWrong?6:o.eyes===2?5:o.eyes===1?4:o.anim===BA.TRAVEL?Math.floor((o.x+o.y)/4)&3:0;
      return base+(o.dir===0||o.dir===3?7:0)+face;
    }
  }
}
function drawPaperBigBox(o,tr){
  if(!paperBigSources[0])return false;
  if(o.boxFold<0||o.boxFade>=1)return true;
  const fade=Math.floor(clamp(o.boxFade,0,1)*16),index=fade?152+(tr.coat-1)*15+fade-1:140+(tr.coat-1)*6+o.boxFold;
  buildPaperBig(index);shSunMax=1;shFlag=0;shBias=0;
  blitSurface=paperLookup.get(paperSpriteHash());blitSprite(o.boxX+6,o.boxY+6,0,false,true);blitSurface=null;return true;
}
function drawPaperBigCat(o,tr){
  if(!paperBigSources[0])return false;
  const index=paperBigCatIndex(o,tr);if(index<0)return true;
  if(o.flapPose>=0)return drawPaperBigFlap(o,tr,index);
  if(o.takeoff>=0)drawPaperBigBox(o,tr);
  buildPaperBig(index);shSunMax=1;shFlag=0;shBias=0;
  const loose=o.takeoff>=0||o.anim===BA.HOP||o.anim===BA.TURN||o.anim===BA.CURL||o.anim===BA.NAP||o.anim===BA.WAKE||o.anim===BA.LEAVE||o.anim===BA.PUZZLED;
  if(o.anim===BA.POP||(o.tunnelPair>=0&&o.z<0))blitClipZ=0;
  const foot=loose&&!o.takeoffSupported&&tr.end!==BOARDANIM.END_WRONG?4:0;
  blitSprite(o.x+(loose?foot:6),o.y+(loose?foot:6),o.z,loose&&(o.dir===0||o.dir===3),true);blitClipZ=-1e9;
  if(o.takeoffSupported){buildPaperBig(145+(tr.coat-1)*6);blitSurface=paperLookup.get(paperSpriteHash());blitSprite(o.boxX+6,o.boxY+6,0,false,true);blitSurface=null;}
  if(o.anim===BA.PUZZLED||o.flapWrong)drawQMark(o.x,o.y,o.z+27,Math.floor(loopT*2)&1);
  return true;
}
function paperBigArrivalPose(o,tr,now){
  if(!tr.n||(tr.end!==BOARDANIM.END_HOME&&tr.end!==BOARDANIM.END_WRONG))return;
  const j=tr.n-1,d=tr.d0[j],T=now-(tr.rel+tr.n*tr.tick),wrong=tr.end===BOARDANIM.END_WRONG;
  const hx=tr.ox+tr.x1[j]*TILE+8,hy=tr.oy+tr.y1[j]*TILE+8,bx=hx-TAKEOFF_DX[d]*16,by=hy-TAKEOFF_DY[d]*16;
  if(T<0){
    if(T<-tr.tick||tr.bn[j]||o.anim===BA.HIDDEN||o.anim===BA.POP)return;
    const u=takeoffEase((T+tr.tick)/(tr.tick*.6));o.x=takeoffQ(lerp(tr.ox+tr.x0[j]*TILE+8,bx,u));o.y=takeoffQ(lerp(tr.oy+tr.y0[j]*TILE+8,by,u));return;
  }
  if(!wrong&&now>=tr.napUntil){
    if(o.anim===BA.WAKE)o.z=3;
    else if(o.anim===BA.LEAVE){const p=clamp((now-tr.napUntil-BOARDANIM.WAKE_LEN)/BOARDANIM.LEAVE_LEN,0,1);o.z+=Math.round(3*(1-p));o.frame=Math.min(3,Math.floor(p*4));}
    return;
  }
  o.dir=o.head=d;o.boxX=bx;o.boxY=by;o.boxFade=wrong?0:clamp((T-1.3)/.8,0,1);
  const slide=takeoffEase(o.boxFade);o.boxX=takeoffQ(bx-Math.SQRT1_2*12*slide);o.boxY=takeoffQ(by+Math.SQRT1_2*12*slide);
  o.boxFold=T<.3?-1:wrong||T<.8?0:T<1.3?Math.min(3,1+Math.floor((T-.8)*6)):T<2.1?4:-1;
  if(T<.3){o.anim=BA.STRETCH;o.x=bx;o.y=by;o.z=0;return;}
  const tx=Math.round((hx+(wrong?3:tr.homeDX))*.5)*2,ty=Math.round((hy+(wrong?3:tr.homeDY))*.5)*2;
  if(T<1.05){
    const u=takeoffEase((T-.65)/.4);o.anim=BA.HOP;o.takeoff=T<.45?0:T<.65?1:T<.8?2:3;o.takeoffSupported=T<.65?1:0;
    const foot=!wrong&&T>=.65?4*(1-u):0;
    o.x=takeoffQ(lerp(bx+6,tx,u)-foot);o.y=takeoffQ(lerp(by+6,ty,u)-foot);o.z=Math.round(lerp(6,wrong?5:3,u)+Math.sin(u*Math.PI)*2);return;
  }
  o.x=tx;o.y=ty;o.z=wrong?5:3;
  if(wrong){o.anim=BA.PUZZLED;o.dir=o.head=1;return;}
  if(T<1.35){o.anim=BA.TURN;o.frame=Math.min(2,Math.floor((T-1.05)*10));return;}
  if(T<2.1){o.anim=BA.CURL;o.frame=Math.min(2,Math.floor((T-1.35)*4));return;}
  o.anim=BA.NAP;o.frame=Math.floor(now/1.5)&1;
}
function drawPaperBigFlap(o,tr,index){
  drawPaperBigBox(o,tr);buildPaperBig(index);
  const r=paperLookup.get(paperSpriteHash()),j=tr.n-1,d=o.dir,mirror=d===0||d===3;
  const hx=tr.ox+tr.x1[j]*TILE+8,hy=tr.oy+tr.y1[j]*TILE+8,p=8+(d<2?EDGE_PORTAL_DATA.outset+EDGE_PORTAL_DATA.housingDepth:EDGE_PORTAL_DATA.backOutset);
  const x=hx+TAKEOFF_DX[d]*(p-(d<2?o.flapBack:-o.flapBack)),y=hy+TAKEOFF_DY[d]*(p-(d<2?o.flapBack:-o.flapBack));
  const ex=mirror?AX-r.entryNative[0]/4+.75:r.entryNative[0]/4-AX,ey=r.entryNative[1]/4-AY;
  const sx=Math.round(x-y-ex),sy=Math.round((x+y)*.5-r.entryMouth[1]-ey);
  shSunMax=1;shFlag=0;shBias=0;blitSurface=r;blitClipSide=-1;blitClipAt=0;
  blitSprite(sy+sx*.5,sy-sx*.5,0,mirror,true);blitSurface=null;return true;
}

function paperBigFlapPose(o,tr,now){
  if(!tr.n||tr.end!==BOARDANIM.END_HOME)return;
  const T=now-(tr.rel+tr.n*tr.tick);if(T<0||T>=EDGE_PORTAL_DATA.arrival.clear)return;
  o.takeoff=-1;o.takeoffSupported=0;
  if(T<.2){o.flapPose=-1;o.anim=BA.STRETCH;o.x=o.boxX;o.y=o.boxY;o.boxFold=-1;return;}
  if(T<EDGE_PORTAL_DATA.arrival.contact){o.flapPose=-1;o.takeoff=T<.34?0:1;o.takeoffSupported=1;o.anim=BA.HOP;o.x=o.boxX+6;o.y=o.boxY+6;o.z=6;o.boxFold=0;return;}
  o.flapPose=Math.min(7,Math.floor((T-EDGE_PORTAL_DATA.arrival.contact)/(EDGE_PORTAL_DATA.arrival.clear-EDGE_PORTAL_DATA.arrival.contact)*8));
}
// ============================================================================
// 28 BOARD PIECES. Every piece sits on a tile; (x0, y0) is the tile's world corner
// and (cx, cy) its centre. All drawn with the scene's own rasterisers and sprites:
//  - turntables: wooden disc + brass rim (plain), ginger disc + striped rim
//    (ginger only), slate-blue disc + plain rim (blue only); a bold arrow along
//    the floor's diagonal; the rim turns while a turntable turns a cat; a hint's
//    turntable (locked in place) sits in a bright brass collar
//  - the delivery hatch: brass-rimmed trapdoor, closed / ajar / open; the closed
//    lid carries the same arrow, showing which way the cats come out
//  - wicker baskets: round (ginger) or square (blue), cushion in the address
//    colour, a dent when empty; at most 6 px tall
//  - the sleeping dog: <= 8 px tall, breathes, ear flops, lifts an ear when bumped
//  - cat flaps in the bank plinth (demo: where napped cats go home)
// ============================================================================
const TT_PLAIN = 0, TT_GINGER = 1, TT_BLUE = 2, TT_R = 7.2, TT_RIM = 1.2;
let ttDir = 0, ttKind = 0, ttSpin = 0, ttLocked = false;
// The direction arrow, hand-placed in screen pixels (world-space shapes this small blur into
// blobs). It lies along the floor's 2:1 diagonal like the glyphs ↘ ↙ ↖ ↗, its head the square
// arrowhead an iso floor shows: ARROW_R points R (screen right-down); U is it upside down
// (screen right-up); D and L are those two mirrored left to right.
const ARROW_R = ['###..........', '.####........', '...####....##', '.....####..##', '.......######', '....#########', '....#########'];
const ARROW_U = ARROW_R.slice().reverse(), ARROW_W = ARROW_R[0].length, ARROW_H = ARROW_R.length;
function arrowDecal(cx, cy, dir, col) {                   // dir: 0 R, 1 D, 2 L, 3 U; centred on the tile centre
  const rows = dir === 0 || dir === 1 ? ARROW_R : ARROW_U, mirror = dir === 1 || dir === 2;
  const x0 = Math.round(cx - cy) + tOX - (ARROW_W >> 1), y0 = Math.round((cx + cy) * 0.5) + tOY - (ARROW_H >> 1);
  const bias = shBias; shBias = bias + 1;
  for (let j = 0; j < ARROW_H; j++) for (let i = 0; i < ARROW_W; i++) {
    if (rows[j].charCodeAt(mirror ? ARROW_W - 1 - i : i) !== 35) continue;   // '#'
    const px = x0 + i, py = y0 + j;
    if (px < 0 || py < 0 || px >= tW || py >= tH) continue;
    const b = py - tOY, a = (px - tOX + 0.5) * 0.5;        // back to the floor point under this pixel
    shLvl = 0;
    emit(px, py, b + a, b - a, 0, F_TOP, col);
  }
  shBias = bias;
}
function shTurntable(face, u, v) {
  const dx = u - 7.5, dy = v - 7.5, r = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), K = ttKind;
  if (r >= TT_R + 0.7) return -1;
  if (r >= TT_R) {                                             // sunk edge, or a hint's brass collar
    if (ttLocked) return C.BR3;
    shLvl = -1; return K === TT_GINGER ? C.CTD : K === TT_BLUE ? C.BC0 : C.BR0;
  }
  const back = dx + dy < -1;                                   // far half catches the window light
  if (r >= TT_R - TT_RIM) {                                    // rim: 8 marks that march round while turning
    const k = fract(Math.atan2(dy, dx) / TAU * 8 + ttSpin * 0.25);
    if (K === TT_GINGER) return k < 0.5 ? C.CT0 : C.CT2;
    if (K === TT_BLUE) return back ? C.BC2 : C.BC0;
    return k < 0.16 ? C.BR0 : back ? C.BR3 : C.BR2;
  }
  if (K === TT_GINGER) return back && r > 3.4 ? C.CT2 : C.CT1;
  if (K === TT_BLUE) return back && r > 3.4 ? C.BC2 : C.BC1;
  const g = fract(v * 0.3 + u * 0.05);                        // a few long grain lines
  return g < 0.12 ? C.WD2 : back && r > 4.2 ? C.WD4 : C.WD3;
}
function drawTurntable(x0, y0, dir, kind, spin, locked) {
  const paper=paperCapturePiece(0,(kind*4+dir)*5+(locked?4:spin),x0+8,y0+8);
  ttDir = dir; ttKind = kind; ttSpin = spin; ttLocked = !!locked;
  shBias = 2;
  faceTop(x0 + 0.5, y0 + 0.5, x0 + 15.5, y0 + 15.5, 0, shTurntable, C.OUT, 0);
  arrowDecal(x0 + 8, y0 + 8, dir, kind === TT_GINGER ? C.CTD : kind === TT_BLUE ? C.CREAM : C.WD0);
  shBias = 0;
  paperFinishPiece(paper);
}

// ---- delivery hatch ------------------------------------------------------------------
let htDir = 0, htOpen = 0;
function shHatch(face, u, v) {                     // u, v in [0, 14): brass frame round two wooden doors
  if (u < 1.3 || v < 1.3) return (u < 1.3 && v < 1.3) ? C.BR2 : C.BR3;
  if (u >= 12.7 || v >= 12.7) return C.BR1;
  const x = u - 7, y = v - 7, p = x * DXS[htDir] + y * DYS[htDir], q = -x * DYS[htDir] + y * DXS[htDir];
  if (htOpen === 2) {                              // open shaft: doors hang down its sides
    if (Math.abs(q) > 4.5) return C.WD1;
    return (u < 2.8 || v < 2.8) ? C.COOL1 : C.DEEP;
  }
  const gap = htOpen === 1 ? 1.4 : 0.3;
  if (Math.abs(q) < gap) return htOpen === 1 ? C.DEEP : C.WD0;          // seam along the way out
  if (htOpen === 1 && Math.abs(q) < gap + 1.1) { shLvl = -1; return C.WD2; }  // door edges tipping down
  if (Math.abs(Math.abs(q) - 4.5) < 0.55 && Math.abs(p) > 3.3 && Math.abs(p) < 4.6) return C.BR1;   // hinges
  return fract(p * 0.42 + 0.15) < 0.16 ? C.WD2 : C.WD3;                  // planks
}
function drawHatch(x0, y0, dir, open) {
  const paper=paperCapturePiece(1,dir*3+open,x0+8,y0+8);
  htDir = dir; htOpen = open;
  shBias = 2;
  faceTop(x0 + 1, y0 + 1, x0 + 15, y0 + 15, 0, shHatch, C.OUT, 0);
  if (open === 0) arrowDecal(x0 + 8, y0 + 8, dir, C.WD0);          // which way the cats come out
  shBias = 0;
  paperFinishPiece(paper);
}

// A small floor badge ties each hatch to H1, H2, … on the Night Shift arrival strip.
const HATCH_DIGITS = [
  ['111', '101', '101', '101', '111'], ['010', '110', '010', '010', '111'],
  ['111', '001', '111', '100', '111'], ['111', '001', '111', '001', '111'],
  ['101', '101', '111', '001', '001'], ['111', '100', '111', '001', '111'],
  ['111', '100', '111', '101', '111'], ['111', '001', '010', '010', '010'],
  ['111', '101', '111', '101', '111'], ['111', '101', '111', '001', '111'],
];
let hatchNumberText = '', hatchNumberWidth = 0;
function shHatchNumber(face, u, v) {
  const x = Math.floor(u), y = 6 - Math.floor(v);
  if (x === 0 || y === 0 || x >= hatchNumberWidth - 1 || y >= 6) return C.BR1;
  if (x < 4) return ['101', '101', '111', '101', '101'][y - 1][x - 1] === '1' ? C.CREAM : C.DEEP;
  const digit = hatchNumberText[Math.floor((x - 5) / 4)], col = (x - 5) % 4;
  return digit && col < 3 && HATCH_DIGITS[Number(digit)][y - 1][col] === '1' ? C.CREAM : C.DEEP;
}
function drawHatchNumber(x0, y0, number) {
  hatchNumberText = String(number); hatchNumberWidth = hatchNumberText.length * 4 + 5;
  shFlat = true; shBias = 18;
  faceY(x0 - 12, x0 - 12 + hatchNumberWidth, 1, 8, y0 + 3, shHatchNumber, C.OUT, 0);
  shFlat = false; shBias = 0;
}

// ---- wicker baskets ----------------------------------------------------------------------
const BK_R = 6.3, BK_H = 4.8, BK_CZ = 2.6, BK_S = 5.7;     // round radius, wall height, cushion z, square half-size
let bkCoat = 1, bkEmpty = true, bkX0 = 0, bkY0 = 0;
function weave(a, h) {                               // woven band: offset 2 x 1 blocks, lighter rim, dark foot
  if (h >= BK_H - 0.9) return C.WD4;
  if (h < 0.8) return C.WD1;
  return ((Math.floor(a) + Math.floor(h * 0.95)) & 1) ? C.WD3 : C.WD2;
}
function shWicker(face, th, h) { return weave(th * 10, h); }
function shWickerIn(face, th, h) { shLvl = h < 1.2 ? -1 : 0; return weave(th * 9, h + BK_CZ); }
function shWickerBox(face, u, v) { return face === F_TOP ? C.WD4 : weave(u * 0.9, v); }
function shWickerBoxIn(face, u, v) { shLvl = v < 1.2 ? -1 : 0; return weave(u * 0.9, v + BK_CZ); }
function cushionAt(dx, dy, rim) {                    // dx, dy from the basket centre; rim = distance to the edge
  const red = bkCoat === 1, hi = red ? C.RD3 : C.BL3, mid = red ? C.RD2 : C.BL2, lo = red ? C.RD1 : C.BL1;
  if (rim < 0.9) return lo;                          // piped edge
  if (bkEmpty) {                                     // the dent a cat leaves
    const e = (dx * dx + dy * dy) / 6.5;
    if (e < 1) return dx + dy > 0.8 ? hi : lo;
  }
  return dx + dy < -2.2 ? hi : mid;
}
function shCushionRound(face, dx, dy) { return cushionAt(dx, dy, BK_R - 0.8 - Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)); }
function shCushionSquare(face, u, v) {
  const dx = u - (BK_S - 0.8), dy = v - (BK_S - 0.8);
  return cushionAt(dx, dy, BK_S - 0.8 - Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy)));
}
function shRimRing(face, u, v) {                     // top of a round basket's wall
  const dx = u - BK_R, dy = v - BK_R, r = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
  if (r >= BK_R || r < BK_R - 0.9) return -1;
  return dx + dy < 0 ? C.WD4 : C.WD3;
}
function shRimFrame(face, u, v) {                    // top of a square basket's wall
  const t = 0.9, L = 2 * BK_S;
  if (u >= t && v >= t && u < L - t && v < L - t) return -1;
  return (u < t || v < t) ? C.WD4 : C.WD3;
}
// Inner (far) wall of a cylinder: like cylinder(), but the back intersection of each column.
function cylinderIn(cx, cy, r, z0, z1, sh, dk) {
  const ac = cx - cy;
  let pa = Math.floor(ac - r * 1.415) - 1 + tOX, pb = Math.ceil(ac + r * 1.415) + 1 + tOX;
  if (pa < 0) pa = 0; if (pb > tW - 1) pb = tW - 1;
  for (let px = pa; px <= pb; px++) {
    const a = px - tOX + 0.5, q = (a - ac) / r;
    if (q <= -1.414 || q >= 1.414) continue;
    const th = -Math.acos(q / Math.SQRT2) - Math.PI / 4;
    const x = cx + r * Math.cos(th), y = cy + r * Math.sin(th);
    const zc = (x + y) * 0.5 + tOY;
    let qa = Math.floor(zc - z1) - 1, qb = Math.ceil(zc - z0) + 1;
    if (qa < 0) qa = 0; if (qb > tH - 1) qb = tH - 1;
    for (let py = qa; py <= qb; py++) {
      const z = zc - py;
      if (z < z0 || z >= z1) continue;
      shLvl = 0;
      const c = sh(F_Y, th + TAU, z - z0);
      if (c < 0) continue;
      emit(px, py, x, y, z, F_Y, c);
    }
  }
}
function drawBasket(cx, cy, coat, occupied) {
  const paper=paperCapturePiece(2,(coat-1)*2+(occupied?1:0),cx,cy);
  bkCoat = coat; bkEmpty = !occupied;
  shSunMax = 1;
  if (coat === 1) {                                  // round: ginger
    disc(cx, cy, BK_R - 0.8, BK_CZ, shCushionRound, coat === 1 ? C.RD0 : C.BL0, false);
    cylinderIn(cx, cy, BK_R - 0.8, BK_CZ, BK_H, shWickerIn, C.WD0);
    faceTop(cx - BK_R, cy - BK_R, cx + BK_R, cy + BK_R, BK_H, shRimRing, C.WD0, 0);
    cylinder(cx, cy, BK_R, 0, BK_H, shWicker, C.WD0, true);
  } else {                                           // square: blue
    const x0 = cx - BK_S, y0 = cy - BK_S, x1 = cx + BK_S, y1 = cy + BK_S, t = 0.9;
    faceTop(x0 + t, y0 + t, x1 - t, y1 - t, BK_CZ, shCushionSquare, C.BL0, 0);
    faceY(x0 + t, x1 - t, BK_CZ, BK_H, y0 + t, shWickerBoxIn, C.WD0, 0);   // inside of the back walls
    faceX(y0 + t, y1 - t, BK_CZ, BK_H, x0 + t, shWickerBoxIn, C.WD0, 0);
    faceTop(x0, y0, x1, y1, BK_H, shRimFrame, C.WD0, 1);
    faceX(y0, y1, 0, BK_H, x1, shWickerBox, C.WD0, 6);                     // outside front walls
    faceY(x0, x1, 0, BK_H, y1, shWickerBox, C.WD0, 6);
  }
  paperFinishPiece(paper);
}

// ---- the sleeping dog ----------------------------------------------------------------------
// A beagle-ish hound lying across the tile facing screen-left: head down on its front
// paws, a long ear, a dark saddle, white-tipped tail. 7 px tall at rest, 8 px breathing in
// (plus the 1 px outline every sprite gets). Frames: rest, breath (the back rises a pixel),
// flop (the ear tip swings) and lift (bumped: the ear pops up for a moment).
const KEY_D = new Uint8Array(128);
KEY = KEY_D;
defKey('B', C.DG1); defKey('S', C.DG0); defKey('D', C.DG0); defKey('E', C.WD1); defKey('T', C.WD1);
defKey('C', C.CREAM); defKey('P', C.PAPSH); defKey('N', C.DEEP); defKey('K', C.WD0); defKey('b', C.WD4);
KEY = KEY_S;
const DOG = {
  rest: [
    '............................',
    '.....BBBB...SSSSSSSSS.....C.',
    '...BBBbbBDESSSSSSSSSSB...DB.',
    '..BBBKKBBDEESSSSSSSSBBB..DB.',
    '.NCCBBBBDEEEEBBBBBBBTBBBDB..',
    '.CCCCBBDEEEEECBBBBBTBBBBB...',
    'CCCCCCCDEEEECCCCPPPCCTCCC...',
    'CCC....DEEE..CCC..CCCC.CCC..',
  ],
  breath: [
    '.............SSSSSS.........',
    '.....BBBB...SSSSSSSSS.....C.',
    '...BBBbbBDESSSSSSSSSSB...DB.',
    '..BBBKKBBDEESSSSSSSSBBB..DB.',
    '.NCCBBBBDEEEEBBBBBBBTBBBDB..',
    '.CCCCBBDEEEEECBBBBBTBBBBB...',
    'CCCCCCCDEEEECCCCPPPCCTCCC...',
    'CCC....DEEE..CCC..CCCC.CCC..',
  ],
  flop: [
    '............................',
    '.....BBBB...SSSSSSSSS.....C.',
    '...BBBbbBDESSSSSSSSSSB...DB.',
    '..BBBKKBBDEESSSSSSSSBBB..DB.',
    '.NCCBBBBDEEEEBBBBBBBTBBBDB..',
    '.CCCCBBDEEEEECBBBBBTBBBBB...',
    'CCCCCCCCEEEECCCCPPPCCTCCC...',
    'CCC......DE..CCC..CCCC.CCC..',
  ],
  lift: [
    '........DE..................',
    '.....BBBBDEESSSSSSSSS.....C.',
    '...BBBbbBDESSSSSSSSSSB...DB.',
    '..BBBKKBBDEESSSSSSSSBBB..DB.',
    '.NCCBBBBBBBBEBBBBBBBTBBBDB..',
    '.CCCCBBBBBBBBCBBBBBTBBBBB...',
    'CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCPPPCCTCCC...',
    'CCC..........CCC..CCCC.CCC..',
  ],
};
const DOG_FRAMES = [DOG.rest, DOG.breath, DOG.flop, DOG.lift];
function buildDog(frame) {
  KEY = KEY_D;
  sprClear();
  tpl(DOG_FRAMES[frame], AX - 13, AY - 7);
  KEY = KEY_S;
  outlineSprite();
}
// t: loop time. earLift > 0 while a cat has just bumped it. Breathes every 1.5 s and flops
// an ear every 12 s (both divide the 48 s loop); z's drift up every 3 s. phase: per dog.
function dogFrame(t, earLift) {
  if (earLift > 0) return 3;
  const fl = Math.floor(fract(t / 12) * 120);
  if (fl >= 60 && fl < 63) return 2;
  return fract(t / 1.5) < 0.34 ? 1 : 0;
}
function drawDog(cx, cy, t, earLift, mirror, phase) {
  const tt = t + phase;
  buildDog(dogFrame(tt, earLift));
  blitSprite(Math.round(cx + 2), Math.round(cy + 2), 0, mirror, true);
  const zt = fract(tt / 3);                                         // z's rise off the head, staying over the dog's own
  if (zt < 0.8) {                                                    // tile so they never cover a neighbour (the coverage check)
    const k = zt / 0.8, big = k > 0.45, sxo = mirror ? 9 - (big ? 4 : 3) - Math.round(k * 2) : -9 + Math.round(k * 2);   // glyph's left edge, px from the tile centre
    drawZ(cx + 2 + sxo * 0.5, cy + 2 - sxo * 0.5, 6 + Math.round(k * 6), big, k);
  }
}
const Z_SMALL = ['###', '.#.', '###'], Z_BIG = ['####', '..#.', '.#..', '####'];
function drawZ(x, y, z, big, fade) {
  const g = big ? Z_BIG : Z_SMALL, px0 = Math.round(x - y) + tOX, py0 = Math.round((x + y) * 0.5 - z) + tOY;
  const d = Math.round((x + y + z) * 4) + 8;
  for (let j = 0; j < g.length; j++) for (let i = 0; i < g[j].length; i++) {
    if (g[j][i] !== '#') continue;
    const px = px0 + i, py = py0 + j;
    if (px < 0 || py < 0 || px >= tW || py >= tH) continue;
    if (fade > 0.55 && bayer(px + tPX, py + tPY) < (fade - 0.55) * 4) continue;   // dithered fade
    const k = py * tW + px;
    if (d < tDep[k]) continue;
    tDep[k] = d; tIdx[k] = C.WHITE | shBoard; tLvl[k] = 2;
  }
}

// ---- cat flaps in the bank plinth (demo) ----------------------------------------------------
// Drawn on the plinth face (plane y = GY0) over a baked dark mouth; open 0..1 swings it in.
let flapColour = 0, flapSwing = 0;
function shCatFlap(face, u, v) {                    // u 0..10 across, v 0..7.2 up; rounded top corners
  if (v > 5.2 && ((u < 2 && (2 - u) * (2 - u) + (v - 5.2) * (v - 5.2) > 4) || (u > 8 && (u - 8) * (u - 8) + (v - 5.2) * (v - 5.2) > 4))) return -1;
  if (u < 0.9 || u >= 9.1 || v >= 6.6) return flapColour;                   // painted surround
  if (v >= 6.0) return C.BR2;                                               // brass hinge bar
  const bottom = flapSwing * 5.5;                                           // the flap swings in from the bottom
  if (v < bottom) return C.DEEP;                                            // dark doorway behind
  if (v < bottom + 0.9) return C.WD1;                                       // flap's lower edge
  return v > 4.8 ? C.WD4 : C.KRAFT2;                                        // flap panel, lit at the top
}
function drawCatFlap(col, red, open) {
  flapColour = red ? C.RD2 : C.BL2; flapSwing = open;
  const x = GX0 + col * TILE + 3;
  shSunMax = 1; shFlag = 0; shBias = 3;
  faceY(x, x + 10, 0.4, 7.6, GY0, shCatFlap, C.OUT, 0);
  shBias = 0;
}
// Flip-flap gate: square brass plate, two floor arrows, a low timber point blade.
// The hinge is at the corner shared by the two exits. Its blade closes the other
// exit, swinging through two stepped positions before resting. Highest point: 4 wu.
// Reuses the board's wood/brass ramps; no additional palette entries or frame allocation.
const GATE_OUTLINE = ['##.......','.##....##','...##..##','....#...#','....#####'];
let gateHX=0,gateHY=0,gateVX=0,gateVY=0;
function shGatePlate(face,u,v) {
  if(u<.75 || v<.75 || u>=13.25 || v>=13.25) return C.BR0;
  if(u<1.5 || v<1.5) return C.BR3;
  if(u>=12.5 || v>=12.5) return C.BR1;
  if((u<3 || u>11) && (v<3 || v>11)) return C.BR2;
  return Math.floor(v)%4===0 ? C.WD0 : C.WD1;
}
function shGateBlade(face,u,v) {
  const x=u-8-gateHX,y=v-8-gateHY,den=gateVX*gateVX+gateVY*gateVY;
  const t=clamp((x*gateVX+y*gateVY)/den,0,1),dx=x-gateVX*t,dy=y-gateVY*t;
  const edge=Math.max(Math.abs(dx),Math.abs(dy));
  if(edge>1) return -1;
  if(edge>.65) return C.WD0;
  return t>.8 ? C.BR2 : t<.18 ? C.BR1 : C.WD3;
}
function shGatePost(face,u,v) { return face===F_TOP ? C.BR3 : face===F_Y ? C.BR1 : C.BR2; }
function gateArrow(cx,cy,dir,open) {
  const rows=open ? ARROW_R : GATE_OUTLINE,mirror=dir===1 || dir===2,up=dir>=2,w=rows[0].length,h=rows.length;
  const x0=Math.round(cx-cy)+tOX-(w>>1),y0=Math.round((cx+cy)*.5)+tOY-(h>>1);
  for(let y=0;y<h;y++)for(let x=0;x<w;x++) {
    if(rows[up?h-1-y:y][mirror?w-1-x:x]!=='#')continue;
    const px=x0+x,py=y0+y;if(px<0 || py<0 || px>=tW || py>=tH)continue;
    const b=py-tOY,a=(px-tOX+.5)*.5;shLvl=0;
    emit(px,py,b+a,b-a,0,F_TOP,open ? C.CREAM : C.WD2);
  }
}
function drawGate(x0,y0,a,b,pose) {
  if(((a+2)&3)===b){drawPoints(x0,y0,a,b,pose);return;}
  const paper=paperCapturePiece(3,paperGateIndex(a,b,pose.state,pose.frame),x0+8,y0+8);
  const flag=shBoard,bias=shBias;shBoard=128;shBias=2;
  faceTop(x0+1,y0+1,x0+15,y0+15,0,shGatePlate,C.OUT,0);
  const open=pose.state ? b : a,closed=pose.state ? a : b;
  shBias=4;
  gateArrow(x0+8+GR_DX[open]-GR_DX[closed]*2,y0+8+GR_DY[open]-GR_DY[closed]*2,open,true);
  gateArrow(x0+8+GR_DX[closed]*3-GR_DX[open]*2,y0+8+GR_DY[closed]*3-GR_DY[open]*2,closed,false);
  // From the shared corner, the blade runs across the closed lane. Reversed
  // swings use the same two intermediate geometries in the opposite order.
  const t=pose.frame===2 ? pose.state : pose.from+(pose.state-pose.from)*(pose.frame+1)/3;
  gateHX=(GR_DX[a]+GR_DX[b])*4;gateHY=(GR_DY[a]+GR_DY[b])*4;
  gateVX=-8*(GR_DX[a]*(1-t)+GR_DX[b]*t);gateVY=-8*(GR_DY[a]*(1-t)+GR_DY[b]*t);
  shBias=0;
  faceTop(x0,y0,x0+16,y0+16,1,shGateBlade,C.OUT,0);
  faceTop(x0,y0,x0+16,y0+16,2,shGateBlade,C.OUT,0);
  box(x0+8+gateHX-1,y0+8+gateHY-1,0,x0+8+gateHX+1,y0+8+gateHY+1,4,shGatePost,C.BR0,2);
  shBoard=flag;shBias=bias;
  paperFinishPiece(paper);
}
// Paper portals are low, two-sided frames outside the active board boundary.
// Textures share the piece atlas; their logical masks supply ordinary world depth.
// The rule-phase symbols remain available for its archived development preview.
let edgeFlapColour = 0;
function shEdgeFlapDebug() { return edgeFlapColour; }
function drawEdgeFlapDebug(x0, y0, side, coat, open) {
  const board = shBoard, bias = shBias;
  shBoard = 128; shBias = 8;
  edgeFlapColour = open ? C.CREAM : coat === COAT_GINGER ? C.RD2 : C.BL1;
  // Leave clearance behind the raised front rail so the address band is visible.
  const x = x0 + 8 + GR_DX[side] * 3, y = y0 + 8 + GR_DY[side] * 3;
  const halfX = side & 1 ? 6 : 1, halfY = side & 1 ? 1 : 6;
  faceTop(x - halfX, y - halfY, x + halfX, y + halfY, 0, shEdgeFlapDebug, C.CREAM, 0);
  if (coat === COAT_BLUE) {
    edgeFlapColour = C.FT0; shBias = 9;
    const gapX = side & 1 ? 2 : halfX, gapY = side & 1 ? halfY : 2;
    faceTop(x - gapX, y - gapY, x + gapX, y + gapY, 0, shEdgeFlapDebug, C.FT0, 0);
    shBias = 8;
  }
  gateArrow(x0 + 8 + GR_DX[side] * 3, y0 + 8 + GR_DY[side] * 3, side, true);
  shBoard = board; shBias = bias;
}

function drawEdgeFlapBand(x0,y0,side,coat) { drawEdgePaperPiece(x0,y0,side,coat,5); }
function drawEdgePortal(x0,y0,side,coat,state=0) { drawEdgePaperPiece(x0,y0,side,coat,state?6:4,state); }
function drawEdgePaperPiece(x0,y0,side,coat,type,state=0) {
  const base=(coat===COAT_BLUE?4:0)+side,index=type===6?base*7+state-1:base;
  drawPaperPhysicalPiece(type,index,x0+8,y0+8,0);
}
function drawPaperPhysicalPiece(type,index,cx,cy,fade=0){
  const r=paperPieceLookup[type][index];
  if(!r)return;
  const paper=paperCapturePiece(type,index,cx,cy),board=shBoard,bias=shBias;
  shBoard=128;shBias=type===5||type===7?1:4;
  const sx0=Math.round(cx-cy),sy0=Math.round((cx+cy)*.5),ax=sx0+tOX,ay=sy0+tOY;
  const snapX=sy0+sx0*.5,snapY=sy0-sx0*.5;
  for(let y=0;y<r.h;y++)for(let x=0;x<r.w;x++){
    const k=y*r.w+x,colour=r.logical[k];if(colour===EMPTY||fade>0&&bayer(r.dx+x+AX,r.dy+y+AY-4)<fade)continue;
    const px=ax+r.dx+x,py=ay+r.dy+y;
    if(px<0||py<0||px>=tW||py>=tH)continue;
    // Recover the original surface point from its baked depth and 2:1 projection.
    const sx=r.dx+x+.5,sy=r.dy+y,sum=(r.depth[k]/4+sy)/1.5;
    const wx=snapX+(sum+sx)/2,wy=snapY+(sum-sx)/2,z=sum/2-sy;
    shLvl=0;emit(px,py,wx,wy,z,r.faces[k],colour);
  }
  shBoard=board;shBias=bias;paperFinishPiece(paper);
}

function drawBoardRailSegment(src,side,from,to) {
  if(to<=from)return;
  const x=src.ox,y=src.oy,x1=x+src.w*TILE,y1=y+src.h*TILE;
  if(side===2)box(x-1.5,y+from,0,x,y+to,1.8,shKerbTop,C.WD0,3);
  else if(side===1)box(x+from,y1,0,x+to,y1+1.5,1.8,shKerbTop,C.WD0,3);
  else box(x1,y+from,0,x1+1.5,y+to,1.8,shKerbTop,C.WD0,3);
}
function drawBoardRails(src) {
  // Preserve the original three boxes exactly when no edge doors are present.
  if(!src.edgeFlaps.length){
    const x=src.ox,y=src.oy,x1=x+src.w*TILE,y1=y+src.h*TILE;
    box(x-1.5,y,0,x,y1+1.5,1.8,shKerbTop,C.WD0,3);
    box(x-1.5,y1,0,x1+1.5,y1+1.5,1.8,shKerbTop,C.WD0,3);
    box(x1,y,0,x1+1.5,y1+1.5,1.8,shKerbTop,C.WD0,3);
    return;
  }
  for(let n=0;n<3;n++){
    const side=n===0?2:n===1?1:0,count=side===1?src.w:src.h;
    let from=side===1?-1.5:0;
    for(let tile=0;tile<count;tile++){
      let door=false;
      for(const f of src.edgeFlaps)if(f.side===side&&(side===1?f.x:f.y)===tile){door=true;break;}
      if(!door)continue;
      const centre=tile*TILE+8,half=EDGE_PORTAL_DATA.railOpening/2;
      drawBoardRailSegment(src,side,from,centre-half);from=centre+half;
    }
    drawBoardRailSegment(src,side,from,count*TILE+1.5);
  }
}
// Roomy one-tile beds for mixed-size boards; normal baskets keep their old art.
function drawLargeBasket(cx,cy,coat,occupied){
  drawPaperPhysicalPiece(12,(coat-1)*2+(occupied?1:0),cx,cy);
}
// Temporary Rule-phase symbols. The final train disc and its paper exports
// belong to Piece; these independent arrows never use the corner gate blade.
let pointsRulePreview=false,pointsRuleFrame=2;
const POINTS_RULE_ARROW=['##.......','.###.....','...###.##','.....####','....#####'];
const POINTS_RULE_SMALL=['#....','.##.#','..###'];
function pointsRuleArrow(cx,cy,dir,active){
  const rows=active?POINTS_RULE_ARROW:POINTS_RULE_SMALL,mirror=dir===1||dir===2,up=dir>=2,w=rows[0].length,h=rows.length;
  const x0=Math.round(cx-cy)+tOX-(w>>1),y0=Math.round((cx+cy)*.5)+tOY-(h>>1);
  for(let y=0;y<h;y++)for(let x=0;x<w;x++){
    if(rows[up?h-1-y:y][mirror?w-1-x:x]!=='#')continue;
    const px=x0+x,py=y0+y;if(px<0||py<0||px>=tW||py>=tH)continue;
    const b=py-tOY,a=(px-tOX+.5)*.5;shLvl=0;emit(px,py,b+a,b-a,0,F_TOP,active?C.CREAM:C.WD0);
  }
}
function shPointsRule(face,u,v){
  const x=u-7,y=v-7,r=x*x+y*y;
  if(r>49)return -1;
  if(r>36)return C.BR0;
  if(r>25)return C.BR2;
  if(Math.abs(x)<1&&Math.abs(y)<1&&pointsRuleFrame<2)return pointsRuleFrame?C.BR2:C.BR3;
  return C.BR1;
}
function drawPointsRule(x0,y0,a,b,pose){
  const flag=shBoard,bias=shBias;shBoard=128;shBias=2;pointsRuleFrame=pose.frame;
  faceTop(x0+1,y0+1,x0+15,y0+15,0,shPointsRule,C.BR0,0);
  shBias=4;
  pointsRuleArrow(x0+8+GR_DX[a]*3,y0+8+GR_DY[a]*3,a,pose.state===0);
  pointsRuleArrow(x0+8+GR_DX[b]*3,y0+8+GR_DY[b]*3,b,pose.state===1);
  shBoard=flag;shBias=bias;
}
// Finished railway points: shared paper base, fixed exit arrows and a small
// rotating centre. All composition happens at load, never in the frame loop.
function pointsArrow(x,y,dir,active){
 const t=x*GR_DX[dir]+y*GR_DY[dir],v=Math.abs(y*GR_DX[dir]-x*GR_DY[dir]);
 const start=active?1.2:2,head=active?3.2:3.9,end=active?6.1:5.9,width=active?2.15:1.55,shaft=active?.85:.55;
 return t>=start&&t<=end&&v<=(t<head?shaft:width*(end-t)/(end-head));
}
function pointsMakePose(a,b,selected,frame){
 const pixels=new Uint8Array(56*56).fill(EMPTY),from=selected===a?b:a;
 const start=Math.atan2(GR_DY[from],GR_DX[from]),end=Math.atan2(GR_DY[selected],GR_DX[selected]);
 let angle=end-start;if(angle>Math.PI)angle-=TAU;if(angle< -Math.PI)angle+=TAU;
 if(Math.abs(Math.abs(angle)-Math.PI)<.001)angle=selected===b?Math.PI:-Math.PI;
 const needle=start+angle*(frame+1)/3,cs=Math.cos(needle),sn=Math.sin(needle),squash=frame===2?1:frame===0?.995:.98;
 for(let y=0;y<56;y++)for(let x=0;x<56;x++){
  const dx=(x+.5)/4-7,dy=(y+.5)/4-7,U=Math.floor((dx/squash+7)*4),V=Math.floor((dy/squash+7)*4);
  if(U<0||U>=56||V<0||V>=56)continue;
  let c=POINTS_BASE[V*56+U];if(c===EMPTY)continue;
  // The dark cut-paper shadow is smaller than a logical pixel.
  if(pointsArrow(dx-.16,dy-.16,a,selected===a)||pointsArrow(dx-.16,dy-.16,b,selected===b))c=C.BR0;
  if(pointsArrow(dx,dy,a,selected===a))c=selected===a?C.CREAM:C.DEEP;
  if(pointsArrow(dx,dy,b,selected===b))c=selected===b?C.CREAM:C.DEEP;
  const t=dx*cs+dy*sn,v=Math.abs(dy*cs-dx*sn);
  if(t>=-.65&&t<=1.65&&v<(t<.25?.22:.42*(1.65-t)/1.4))c=C.WD0;
  if(dx*dx+dy*dy<.22)c=C.BR2;
  if(frame<2&&Math.abs(dx+4.6)<.18&&Math.abs(dy+4.6)<(frame?.36:.2))c=C.SUN1;
  pixels[y*56+x]=c;
 }
 return {selected,from,frame,pixels};
}
const POINTS_POSES=(function(){
 const poses=new Array(96),shared=new Map();
 for(let a=0;a<4;a++)for(let b=0;b<4;b++)if(a!==b)for(let state=0;state<2;state++)for(let frame=0;frame<3;frame++){
  const lo=Math.min(a,b),hi=Math.max(a,b),selected=state?b:a,key=(lo*4+hi)*6+(selected===hi?3:0)+frame;
  let p=shared.get(key);if(!p){p=pointsMakePose(lo,hi,selected,frame);shared.set(key,p);}
  poses[(a*4+b)*6+state*3+frame]=p;
 }
 return poses;
})();
function pointsPose(a,b,state,frame){return POINTS_POSES[(a*4+b)*6+(state?3:0)+clamp(frame|0,0,2)];}
let pointsPaint=null;
function shPointsPaper(face,u,v){
 const x=Math.floor((u-1)*4),y=Math.floor((v-1)*4),c=x<0||x>=56||y<0||y>=56?EMPTY:pointsPaint[y*56+x];
 if(c!==EMPTY)return c;
 // Cover edge cells logically, then restore their floor through the paper mask.
 // The native4x capture still follows the exact generated transparent cut edge.
 if((!paperStaticCapturing||paperStaticPrimitive)&&(u-8)*(u-8)+(v-8)*(v-8)<73)return C.BR1;
 return -1;
}
function drawPoints(x0,y0,a,b,pose){
 const frame=clamp(pose.frame|0,0,2),state=pose.state?1:0;
 const paper=paperCapturePiece(8,(a*4+b)*6+state*3+frame,x0+8,y0+8),flag=shBoard,bias=shBias;
 pointsPaint=pointsPose(a,b,state,frame).pixels;shBoard=128;shBias=1;
 // Paper thickness is baked into the paint; the floor depth keeps native
 // box ground-contact texels in front of the disc.
 faceTop(x0,y0,x0+16,y0+16,0,shPointsPaper,C.BR0,0);
 shBoard=flag;shBias=bias;paperFinishPiece(paper);
}
// Rule-study markers only. Finished hoods/occlusion/puffs belong to Piece.
// Symbol identity never depends on colour; either selected endpoint lights both.
function tunnelPairAt(pairs,x,y){
  if(pairs)for(let i=0;i<pairs.length;i++){
    const t=pairs[i];if((t.a.x===x&&t.a.y===y)||(t.b.x===x&&t.b.y===y))return i;
  }
  return -1;
}
let tunnelRuleSymbol=0,tunnelRuleActive=false;
function shTunnelRule(face,u,v){
  const x=u-7,y=v-7,r=x*x+y*y;if(r>49)return -1;
  if(r>36)return tunnelRuleActive?C.WHITE:C.BR0;
  if(r>25)return C.BR2;
  const ink=tunnelRuleSymbol===0?r>=6&&r<=16:tunnelRuleSymbol===1?Math.max(Math.abs(x),Math.abs(y))>=2.3&&Math.max(Math.abs(x),Math.abs(y))<=3.3:
    tunnelRuleSymbol===2?y>=-3&&y<=3&&Math.abs(x)<=(y+3)*.55:Math.abs(x)+Math.abs(y)<=3;
  return ink?C.BL0:C.CREAM;
}
function drawTunnelRule(x,y,symbol,active){
  const flag=shBoard,bias=shBias;shBoard=128;shBias=3;
  tunnelRuleSymbol=symbol;tunnelRuleActive=active;
  faceTop(x+1,y+1,x+15,y+15,0,shTunnelRule,C.BR0,0);
  shBoard=flag;shBias=bias;
}
// Finished all-side pneumatic hoods. Prepare indexed paper at load; traces select
// endpoint-local effects without allocating or changing the instantaneous rules.
const TUNNEL_TINT=[C.BR2,C.CD0,C.KRAFT,C.BR1];
const TUNNEL_TAGS=['idle','entry','transit','exit'];
function tunnelEngraving(s,x,y){
 const r=Math.hypot(x,y),a=Math.abs(x),b=Math.abs(y);
 if(s===0)return r>1.25&&r<2.05;
 if(s===1)return Math.max(a,b)>1.3&&Math.max(a,b)<2.05;
 if(s===2)return y>=-2&&y<=1.8&&a<=(y+2)*.56&&(y>1||a>(y+2)*.56-.75);
 return a+b>1.65&&a+b<2.65;
}
function tunnelMakeHood(s,pose,active){
 const p=new Uint8Array(56*56).fill(EMPTY);
 for(let y=0;y<56;y++)for(let x=0;x<56;x++){
  const u=(x+.5)/4-7,v=(y+.5)/4-7,r=Math.hypot(u,v),i=y*56+x,base=POINTS_BASE[i];
  if(base===EMPTY||r>6.9)continue;
  const grain=PALRGB[base][0]<175;
  let c=r>6.35?C.BR0:r>5.8?(v< -u?C.BR3:C.BR1):r>4.8?(grain?C.BR1:base):r>4.3?C.BR0:C.DEEP;
  // Retractable brass iris sits below a wide paper collar. A changing aperture
  // keeps the symbol plate and rivets visible while the native box sinks.
  const aperture=pose===0?1.15:pose===1?3.65:pose===2?4.2:3.9;
  if(r<4.3&&r>aperture){
   c=grain?C.BR1:TUNNEL_TINT[s];
   if(Math.abs(u)<.16||Math.abs(v)<.16)c=C.BR0;
   if(r>4.05)c=C.BR3;
  }
  // Four layered mounting tabs and rivets retain the brass hood's cut edges.
  for(let d=0;d<4;d++){
   const a=u-GR_DX[d]*5.55,b=v-GR_DY[d]*5.55;
   if(a*a+b*b<.19)c=C.BR0;
   if((a+.12)*(a+.12)+(b+.12)*(b+.12)<.075)c=C.CREAM;
  }
  // Cream enamel badge on the far rim, engraved independently of brass tint.
  const bx=u+2.75,by=v+2.75;
  if(bx*bx+by*by<6.5){c=bx*bx+by*by>5.6?C.BR0:C.CREAM;if(tunnelEngraving(s,(bx-by)*.78,(bx+by)*.46))c=C.BL0;}
  if(active&&r>6.05&&r<6.4)c=C.CREAM;
  if(pose===2&&r<1.05)c=C.BR3;
  p[i]=c;
 }
 return p;
}
const TUNNEL_HOODS=Array.from({length:32},(_,i)=>tunnelMakeHood(i>>3,(i>>1)&3,i&1));
function tunnelHoodPose(symbol,pose,active){return TUNNEL_HOODS[(symbol<<3)+(pose<<1)+(active?1:0)];}
// Bits0..1 pose; bit2 partner focus; bits3..5 puff+1. Select each real endpoint
// independently: two opposing cats may enter and emerge at the same tile.
function tunnelPieceState(src,x,y,pair){
 let pose=0,puff=-1;
 for(let i=0;i<src.n;i++){
  const tr=src.traces[i],now=src.times[i];if(!tr||now<0)continue;
  const k=Math.floor((now-tr.rel)/tr.tick+1e-9);if(k<0||k>=tr.n||tr.ev[k]!==BOARDANIM.EV_TUNNEL||tr.tunnel[k]!==pair)continue;
  const f=clamp((now-tr.rel)/tr.tick-k,0,1),entry=tr.entryX[k]===x&&tr.entryY[k]===y,exit=tr.x1[k]===x&&tr.y1[k]===y;
  if(entry){pose=Math.max(pose,f<.45?1:f<.65?2:0);if(f>=.25&&f<.55)puff=Math.max(puff,Math.min(3,Math.floor((f-.25)/.3*4)));}
  if(exit){pose=Math.max(pose,f<.65?2:3);if(f>=.65&&f<.99)puff=Math.max(puff,Math.min(3,Math.floor((f-.65)/.34*4)));}
 }
 return pose|((src.tunnelFocus===pair||pose>0)?4:0)|((puff+1)<<3);
}
let tunnelPaint=null,tunnelPuffPose=0;
function shTunnelPaper(face,u,v){
 const x=Math.floor((u-1)*4),y=Math.floor((v-1)*4),c=x<0||y<0||x>=56||y>=56?EMPTY:tunnelPaint[y*56+x];
 if(c!==EMPTY)return c;
 if((!paperStaticCapturing||paperStaticPrimitive)&&(u-8)*(u-8)+(v-8)*(v-8)<81)return C.BR0;
 return -1;
}
function shTunnelBevel(face,u,v){return v<.3?C.BR0:v>.9?C.BR3:Math.sin(u*10)>.8?C.BR1:C.BR2;}
function drawTunnelHood(x,y,symbol,pose,active){
 const paper=paperCapturePiece(9,(symbol<<3)+(pose<<1)+(active?1:0),x+8,y+8),flag=shBoard,bias=shBias;
 tunnelPaint=tunnelHoodPose(symbol,pose,active);shBoard=128;shBias=1;
 cylinder(x+8,y+8,6.9,0,1.2,shTunnelBevel,C.BR0,0);
 faceTop(x,y,x+16,y+16,1.2,shTunnelPaper,C.BR0,0);
 shBoard=flag;shBias=bias;paperFinishPiece(paper);
}
function shTunnelPuff(face,u,v){
 const q=tunnelPuffPose,x=u-6,z=v,r=1+q*.32;
 // Split wisps leave a clear centre for the emerging ears and heading.
 const a=(x+3+q*.3)*(x+3+q*.3)/(r*r)+(z-2-q*.8)*(z-2-q*.8)/(r*r*1.5),b=(x-3-q*.3)*(x-3-q*.3)/(r*r)+(z-3-q)*(z-3-q)/(r*r*1.1);
 if(a>1&&b>1)return (!paperStaticCapturing||paperStaticPrimitive)?C.CR1:-1;
 if(q===3&&paperStaticCapturing&&!paperStaticPrimitive&&((Math.floor(u*4)+Math.floor(v*4))%5===0))return -1;
 return z<2+q*.8?C.CR1:C.CREAM;
}
function drawTunnelPuff(x,y,pose){
 const p=paperCapturePiece(10,pose,x+8,y+8),flag=shBoard,bias=shBias;tunnelPuffPose=pose;shBoard=128;shBias=2;
 faceY(x+2,x+14,1,12,y+8,shTunnelPuff,C.PAPSH,0);shBoard=flag;shBias=bias;paperFinishPiece(p);
}
function drawTunnelPiece(src,t){
 const state=tunnelPieceState(src,t.x,t.y,t.pair),x=bdX(src,t.x),y=bdY(src,t.y);
 drawTunnelHood(x,y,t.symbol,state&3,(state&4)!==0);
 const puff=(state>>3)-1;if(puff>=0)drawTunnelPuff(x,y,puff);
}
// One shared glass inspection section carries brief event accents. This is a
// decorative clock, never a second rules movement or a route across the floor.
function tunnelWallSignal(src,pair){
 for(let i=0;i<src.n;i++){
  const tr=src.traces[i],now=src.times[i];if(!tr||now<0)continue;
  const v=(now-tr.rel)/tr.tick,k=Math.floor(v+1e-9);
  if(k<0||k>=tr.n||tr.ev[k]!==BOARDANIM.EV_TUNNEL||tr.tunnel[k]!==pair)continue;
  const f=v-k;if(f>=.3&&f<.85)return Math.floor((f-.3)/.55*255);
 }
 return -1;
}
// ============================================================================
// 29 PROPS (drawn per frame): clock hands, pendant lamp, plants, conveyor
// rollers/flat-packs/curtain, the shelf's flat-box stack, mug, stamp, the cat's
// box on the counter and the chute flap. Moving parts read WS (sim/14_world).
// ============================================================================
// ---- generic billboard blob (leaves, shade parts): ellipse in screen space ------------
let blobShade = 0;                     // 0 leaf, 1 brass
function blob(x, y, z, rx, ry, dark) {
  const cx = Math.round(x - y) + tOX, cy = Math.round((x + y) * 0.5 - z) + tOY;
  const d0 = (x + y + z) * 4;
  for (let j = -ry - 1; j <= ry + 1; j++) for (let i = -rx - 1; i <= rx + 1; i++) {
    const px = cx + i, py = cy + j;
    if (px < 0 || py < 0 || px >= tW || py >= tH) continue;
    const e = (i * i) / ((rx + 0.5) * (rx + 0.5)) + (j * j) / ((ry + 0.5) * (ry + 0.5));
    const eo = (i * i) / ((rx + 1.3) * (rx + 1.3)) + (j * j) / ((ry + 1.3) * (ry + 1.3));
    if (eo > 1) continue;
    const k = py * tW + px, dep = Math.round(d0 - j * 2) + 1;
    if (dep < tDep[k]) continue;
    const wx = x + i * 0.5, wy = y - i * 0.5, wz = z - j;
    let c, lv = 0;
    if (e > 1) { c = blobShade === 0 ? C.PT1 : C.BR1; }
    else if (blobShade === 0) {
      c = i < 0 ? C.PT2 : C.PT1;                  // two overlapping leaf papers
    } else {
      const l = -i / (rx + 0.5) * 0.6 - j / (ry + 0.5) * 0.5;
      c = l > 0.4 ? C.BR3 : l > -0.2 ? C.BR2 : C.BR1;
    }
    tDep[k] = dep;
    let add = 0;
    const a = sunFn(wx, wy, wz, F_TOP);
    if (a > 0.5) add = 1;
    if (lampFn !== null) add += lampFn(wx, wy, wz, px + tPX, py + tPY);
    tIdx[k] = c | shBoard; tLvl[k] = clamp(2 + lv + add, 0, 4);
  }
}
// ---- clock hands ------------------------------------------------------------------
function plotPlaneY(x, y, z, c) {       // one pixel on a +y facing plane, no lighting
  const px = Math.round(x - y - 0.5) + tOX, py = Math.round((x + y) * 0.5 - z) + tOY;
  if (px < 0 || py < 0 || px >= tW || py >= tH) return;
  const k = py * tW + px, d = Math.round((x + y + z) * 4) + 6;
  if (d < tDep[k]) return;
  tDep[k] = d; tIdx[k] = c | shBoard; tLvl[k] = 2;
}
function drawClock(t) {
  const m = Math.floor((t / SCN.demo.loop) * 60) / 60;          // minute hand: 1 turn per loop, 60 ticks
  const am = m * TAU, ah = (4.75 / 12) * TAU;             // hour hand rests near 5 o'clock
  for (let r = 0; r <= 4.6; r += 0.5) plotPlaneY(CLOCK_X + Math.sin(am) * r, 0.7, CLOCK_Z + Math.cos(am) * r, C.OUT);
  for (let r = 0; r <= 3.0; r += 0.5) plotPlaneY(CLOCK_X + Math.sin(ah) * r, 0.8, CLOCK_Z + Math.cos(ah) * r, C.WD0);
  plotPlaneY(CLOCK_X, 0.9, CLOCK_Z, C.BR3);
}
