// ---- pendant lamp: chain, brass shade, glowing bulb; sways on a 12 s period (WS.lampSX) ------
const LAMP_Z = SCN.lamp.z;
function shRing(face, th, h) { return th > 1.1 ? C.BR3 : th > 0.4 ? C.BR2 : C.BR1; }
function shRim(face, th, h) { return h < 0.8 ? C.BR1 : th > 1.0 ? C.BR3 : C.BR2; }
function shBulb(face, dx, dy) { shFlat = true; return C.SUN1; }
function drawLamp() {
  shSunMax = 1; shFlag = 0;
  const x = LAMP_X + WS.lampSX * 0.5, y = LAMP_Y - WS.lampSX * 0.5;
  for (let z = LAMP_ARM_Z - 2; z > LAMP_Z + 4; z -= 1) {
    const f = (LAMP_ARM_Z - 2 - z) / (LAMP_ARM_Z - LAMP_Z - 6);
    dot3(LAMP_X + (x - LAMP_X) * f, LAMP_Y + (y - LAMP_Y) * f, z, (z & 1) ? C.BR1 : C.BR2, 0);
  }
  cylinder(x, y, 1.0, LAMP_Z + 5, LAMP_Z + 6.5, shRing, C.BR0, false);
  cylinder(x, y, 2.2, LAMP_Z + 4, LAMP_Z + 5, shRing, C.BR0, false);
  cylinder(x, y, 3.6, LAMP_Z + 3, LAMP_Z + 4, shRing, C.BR0, false);
  cylinder(x, y, 4.6, LAMP_Z + 1.5, LAMP_Z + 3, shRing, C.BR0, false);
  cylinder(x, y, 5.4, LAMP_Z, LAMP_Z + 1.5, shRim, C.BR0, true);
  disc(x, y, 2.0, LAMP_Z - 0.6, shBulb, C.SUN0, false);
  dot3(x + 0.5, y + 0.5, LAMP_Z - 1.6, C.WHITE, 0);
  shFlat = false;
}
// Lamp light: warm pool on whatever is under the bulb (dynamic pixels use lampFn,
// baked pixels get the same through a post pass).
const LAMP_R = SCN.lamp.r;
function lampLight(x, y, z, wpx, wpy) {
  const lx = LAMP_X + WS.lampSX * 0.5, ly = LAMP_Y - WS.lampSX * 0.5, lz = LAMP_Z - 1;
  if (z > lz + 2) return 0;                                    // the shade blocks upward light
  const dx = x - lx, dy = y - ly, dz = (z - lz) * 0.35;
  const d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);
  if (d >= LAMP_R) return 0;
  const a = 1 - d / LAMP_R;
  return a > 0.44 ? 1 : 0;                                    // one quiet cut-paper pool
}
// ---- plants ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Tall plant between the windows: [dx, dy, z, rx, ry, phase]
const LEAVES1 = SCN.plants.tall.leaves;       // [dx, dy, z, rx, ry, phase]
const LEAVES2 = SCN.plants.trailing.leaves;
function drawPlants(t) {
  const ph = t / 6 * TAU;
  blobShade = 0;
  // stems
  shSunMax = 1; shFlag = 0;
  for (let z = PLANT1.h - 1; z < 37; z++) dot3(PLANT1.x + Math.round(Math.sin(z * 0.3)) * 0.5, PLANT1.y, z, C.PT0, 0);
  for (let k = 0; k < LEAVES1.length; k++) {
    const L = LEAVES1[k], bob = Math.round(Math.sin(ph + L[5]) * 0.7);
    blob(PLANT1.x + L[0], PLANT1.y + L[1], L[2] + bob, L[3], L[4], C.PT0);
  }
  // trailing plant on top of the parcel shelf: vine down the front edge
  for (let z = PLANT2.z + 2; z > PLANT2.z - 14; z--) dot3(PLANT2.x + 1, PLANT2.y + 8.5, z, C.PT1, 0);
  for (let k = 0; k < LEAVES2.length; k++) {
    const L = LEAVES2[k], bob = Math.round(Math.sin(ph * 1.0 + L[5]) * 0.6);
    blob(PLANT2.x + L[0], PLANT2.y + L[1], PLANT2.z + L[2] + bob, L[3], L[4], C.PT0);
  }
}
// ---- conveyor: rollers, flat-packs (WS.conveyor.items: x or NaN), rubber curtain ----------------
const PAR_W = SCN.conveyor.item.w, PAR_D = SCN.conveyor.item.d, PAR_H = SCN.conveyor.item.h;
function shRollers(face, u, v) {
  if (face !== F_TOP) return C.FT0;
  const k = ((u - WS.conveyor.roll) % 4 + 4) % 4;
  return k < 1 ? C.PL0 : k < 2 ? C.FT1 : k < 3 ? C.FT2 : C.FT1;
}
function drawConveyor() {
  const cv = WS.conveyor;
  shSunMax = 1; shFlag = 0;
  faceTop(CV_X0 + 0.5, CV_Y0, CV_X1 - 1, CV_Y1, CV_Z, shRollers, C.PL0, 0);
  for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
    const x = cv.items[k];
    if (x !== x) continue;                            // NaN
    const qx = Math.round(x * 0.5) * 2;
    if (qx + PAR_W <= 0.5) continue;
    parcelClip(Math.max(0.5, qx), CV_Y0 + 1.5, CV_Z, qx + PAR_W, CV_Y0 + 1.5 + PAR_D, CV_Z + PAR_H, qx, 21);
    if (k === cv.riderOn && qx > 1) {                // a cat riding contentedly on top
      shSunMax = 1;
      buildLoose(COAT_GINGER, 'curl', Math.floor(loopT / 1.5) & 1, 0);
      blitSprite(qx + 5, CV_Y0 + 6, CV_Z + PAR_H, false, true);
    }
  }
  drawCurtain();
}
function parcelClip(x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, ox, seed) {
  pW = PAR_W; pD = PAR_D; pH = PAR_H; pSeed = seed;
  shOffU = x0 - ox;
  box(x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, shFlatPackOff, C.KRAFT0, 3);
  shOffU = 0;
}
// A bundle of flattened boxes: layered kraft edges, a string cross over the top.
function shFlatPack(face, u, v) {
  if (face === F_TOP) {
    if (Math.abs(u - pW * 0.5) < 0.5 || Math.abs(v - pD * 0.5) < 0.5) return C.CREAM;
    return (u < 0.8 || v < 0.8) ? C.KRAFT2 : C.KRAFT;
  }
  const layer = Math.floor(v * 1.4) & 1;
  if (face === F_Y && Math.abs(u - pW * 0.5) < 0.5) return C.CREAM;
  if (face === F_X && Math.abs(u - pD * 0.5) < 0.5) return C.CREAM;
  return face === F_Y ? (layer ? C.KRAFT : C.KRAFT2) : (layer ? C.KRAFT0 : C.KRAFT);
}
function shFlatPackOff(face, u, v) { return shFlatPack(face, face === F_X ? u : u + shOffU, v); }
let shOffU = 0;
function shParcelOff(face, u, v) { return shParcel(face, face === F_X ? u : u + shOffU, v); }
function shStrip(face, u, v) { return (Math.floor(u / 2) & 1) ? C.COOL1 : C.DEEP; }
function drawCurtain() {
  // strips hang in the hatch opening (plane x = 0.3); a passing parcel lifts them
  const x = WS.conveyor.items[2];
  const passing = x === x && x < 1 && x > WS.conveyor.enter + 1;
  shSunMax = 0; shFlag = 0; shBias = 2;
  for (let s = 0; s < 7; s++) {
    const y0 = CV_Y0 + 0.5 + s * 2, y1 = y0 + 1.6;
    let zb = CV_Z - 1.5;
    if (passing && y1 > CV_Y0 + 1.5 && y0 < CV_Y0 + 1.5 + PAR_D) zb = CV_Z + PAR_H + 0.5;
    faceX(y0, y1, zb, CV_Z + 18, 0.3, shStrip, C.OUT, 0);
  }
  shBias = 0;
}
// Flat boxes stacked on the middle shelf: SHELVE adds one on top, and the sorter takes
// the top one to open for COLLECT. lift: the top box raised in the sorter's hand (0..1).
function drawShelfStack(n, lift) {
  const S = SCN.shelf.stack;
  shSunMax = 1; shFlag = 0;
  pW = S.x1 - S.x0; pD = S.y1 - S.y0;
  for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
    const z = S.z + k * S.h + (k === n - 1 ? lift * 3 : 0), j = (k * 3 + 1) % 4 * 0.3;
    pH = S.h;
    box(S.x0 + j, S.y0 + (k & 1) * 0.4, z, S.x1 + j, S.y1 + (k & 1) * 0.4, z + S.h - 0.2, shFlatBox, C.KRAFT0, 3);
  }
}
function shFlatBox(face, u, v) {
  if (face === F_TOP) return (u < 0.8 || v < 0.8) ? C.KRAFT2 : C.KRAFT;
  return face === F_Y ? C.KRAFT : C.KRAFT0;
}
// ---- mug on window 1's sill, stamp, the cat's box on the counter, chute flap ----------------
const MUG_X = SCN.props.mug[0], MUG_Y = SCN.props.mug[1], MUG_Z = SCN.props.mug[2];
function shMug(face, th, h) { return h > 2.5 ? C.WHITE : th > 1.0 ? C.CREAM : C.PAPSH; }
function shTea(face, dx, dy) { return C.WD1; }
function drawMugAt(x, y, z) {
  shSunMax = 1; shFlag = 0;
  cylinder(x, y, 1.6, z, z + 3.2, shMug, C.PAPSH, true);
  disc(x, y, 1.1, z + 2.7, shTea, C.WD0, false);
  dot3(x + 1.8, y + 0.5, z + 2, C.CREAM, 0); dot3(x + 2.2, y + 0.5, z + 1.2, C.CREAM, 0);
}
const STAMP_X = SCN.props.stamp[0], STAMP_Y = SCN.props.stamp[1], INK_X0 = SCN.props.ink[0], INK_Y0 = SCN.props.ink[1];
function shStampHandle(face, th, h) { return h > 3 ? C.WD4 : th > 1 ? C.WD3 : C.WD2; }
function drawStampAt(x, y, z) {
  shSunMax = 1; shFlag = 0;
  box(x - 1.5, y - 1.5, z, x + 1.5, y + 1.5, z + 1, shInkBlock, C.OUT, 3);
  cylinder(x, y, 0.9, z + 1, z + 4.5, shStampHandle, C.WD0, false);
  disc(x, y, 1.3, z + 4.5, shWoodTop, C.WD1, false);
}
function shInkBlock(face, u, v) { return face === F_TOP ? C.WD2 : C.DEEP; }
function shWoodTop(face, dx, dy) { return C.WD4; }
// The collected cat in its box on the chute's flap (WS.counter): a cream label on the box's front-right
// face; the paw stamp comes down on it (thunk: the cat blinks, a paw on the label), then the flap
// opens and the box sinks through the counter top.
const PAW_LABEL = ['D.D', '.D.', '...'];                                // per label column, rows follow the face's slope
// The paw stamp as sprite pixels (dx, dy, colour from its rubber at (x0, y0)): rubber, block, handle,
// brass knob; ringed in OUT after the box's outline pass, so it reads over the box and the cat.
const STAMP_SPR = [0, 0, C.DEEP, 1, 0, C.DEEP, 2, 0, C.DEEP, 0, -1, C.WD1, 1, -1, C.WD2, 2, -1, C.WD1,
  1, -2, C.WD3, 1, -3, C.WD3, 1, -4, C.BR3, 2, -4, C.BR2];
function stampPixels(x0, y0) {
  for (let k = 0; k < STAMP_SPR.length; k += 3) for (let n = 0; n < 4; n++) {
    const x = x0 + STAMP_SPR[k] + (n === 0 ? -1 : n === 1 ? 1 : 0), y = y0 + STAMP_SPR[k + 1] + (n === 2 ? -1 : n === 3 ? 1 : 0);
    if (x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < SW && y < SHT) { SPR[y * SW + x] = 253; SPO[y * SW + x] = C.OUT; }
  }
  for (let k = 0; k < STAMP_SPR.length; k += 3) sp(x0 + STAMP_SPR[k], y0 + STAMP_SPR[k + 1], STAMP_SPR[k + 2]);
}
function drawCounterBox() {
  const B = WS.counter;
  if (!B.boxOn) return;
  shSunMax = 1; shFlag = 0; shBias = 0;
  catBoxPixels(COAT_GINGER, 1, 1, 0, B.eyes ? 1 : 0, 0, 0, true);
  const bx = AX, by = AY - 4;
  for (let c = 0; c < 3; c++) {                                        // box columns 2..4: the face starts 2 below the rim
    const x = 2 + c, top = by + 1 - (x >> 1);
    for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) sp(bx + x, top + r, B.stamped && PAW_LABEL[r][c] === 'D' ? C.DEEP : C.CREAM);
  }
  outlineSprite();
  if (B.stampZ >= 0) stampPixels(bx + 2, by - 1 - B.stampZ);           // upright, its rubber on the label's top edge
  blitClipZ = CTR_Z + 3;
  blitSprite(B.x, B.y, B.z, false, true);
  blitClipZ = -1e9;
}
// The chute's wooden flap: shut flush in its brass rim, swung up against the hinge while a box drops.
function shChuteLid(face, u, v) { return face === F_TOP ? C.WD3 : C.WD2; }
function drawChuteFlap(open) {
  const CH = SCN.counter.props.chute, T = CTR_Z + 3, x0 = CH[0] + 1, x1 = CH[2] - 1, y0 = CH[1] + 1, y1 = CH[3] - 1;
  shSunMax = 1; shFlag = 0; shBias = 2;
  if (open < 0.25) { faceTop(x0, y0, x1, y1, T, shChuteLid, C.WD1, 0); dot3((x0 + x1) * 0.5, y1 - 1, T, C.BR3, 0); }
  else if (open < 0.75) box(x0, y0, T, x1, y0 + 3, T + 3, shChuteLid, C.WD1, 1);
  else faceY(x0, x1, T, T + y1 - y0, y0 + 0.5, shChuteLid, C.WD1, 7);
  shBias = 0;
}
// ============================================================================
// 30 PARTICLES. The room's loop (sim/14_world events) and the demo board use
// analytic events: every particle is a closed-form function of its age, so the
// loop point is seamless. The game's sparkles and hearts use a preallocated pool
// (200). Dust motes are stateless functions of loop phase and only show where
// the sunlight is.
// ============================================================================
const PMAX = 200, P_STEAM = 1, P_INK = 2, P_SPARK = 3, P_PUFF = 4, P_HEART = 5;
const PX = new Float32Array(PMAX), PY = new Float32Array(PMAX), PZ = new Float32Array(PMAX);
const PVX = new Float32Array(PMAX), PVY = new Float32Array(PMAX), PVZ = new Float32Array(PMAX);
const PLIFE = new Float32Array(PMAX), PMAXL = new Float32Array(PMAX), PTYPE = new Uint8Array(PMAX), PCOL = new Uint8Array(PMAX);
const PPH = new Float32Array(PMAX);
let pNext = 0;
function pSpawn(type, x, y, z, vx, vy, vz, life, col) {
  const cap=ACTIVE_ROOM.id==='depot'?152:PMAX;
  for (let n = 0; n < cap; n++) {
    const i = (pNext + n) % cap;
    if (PTYPE[i] === 0) {
      PTYPE[i] = type; PX[i] = x; PY[i] = y; PZ[i] = z; PVX[i] = vx; PVY[i] = vy; PVZ[i] = vz;
      PLIFE[i] = life; PMAXL[i] = life; PCOL[i] = col; PPH[i] = rnd() * TAU;
      pNext = (i + 1) % cap; return;
    }
  }
}
function pReset() { PTYPE.fill(0); pNext = 0; }
function spawnSparkles(x, y, z, col) {
  for (let k = 0; k < 7; k++) {
    const a = (k / 7) * Math.PI + rnd() * 0.4, s = 10 + rnd() * 14;
    pSpawn(P_SPARK, x + (rnd() - 0.5) * 6, y + 1, z, Math.cos(a) * s * 0.7, s * 0.25, Math.sin(a) * s * 0.6 + 6, 0.45 + rnd() * 0.35,
      k & 1 ? C.WHITE : (col === RED ? C.RD4 : C.BL4));
  }
}
// One tiny heart rising slowly from a cat that has just curled up at home.
function spawnHeart(x, y, z) { pSpawn(P_HEART, x, y, z, 0, 0, 5, 1.3, C.RD3); }
function spawnInk(x, y, z) {
  for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
    const a = rnd() * TAU, s = 8 + rnd() * 10;
    pSpawn(P_INK, x, y, z, Math.cos(a) * s, Math.sin(a) * s, 10 + rnd() * 8, 0.3 + rnd() * 0.2, k & 1 ? C.DEEP : C.COOL1);
  }
}
function spawnSteam(x, y, z) {
  pSpawn(P_STEAM, x + (rnd() - 0.5), y, z, 0, 0, 5 + rnd() * 2, 1.4 + rnd() * 0.5, C.WHITE);
}
function spawnPuff(x, y, z, n) {
  for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
    const a = rnd() * TAU;
    pSpawn(P_PUFF, x, y, z, Math.cos(a) * 9, Math.sin(a) * 9, 3 + rnd() * 3, 0.35 + rnd() * 0.2, C.BG0);
  }
}
function updateParticles(dt) {
  const cap=ACTIVE_ROOM.id==='depot'?152:PMAX;
  for (let i = 0; i < cap; i++) {
    if (PTYPE[i] === 0) continue;
    PLIFE[i] -= dt;
    if (PLIFE[i] <= 0) { PTYPE[i] = 0; continue; }
    const t = PTYPE[i];
    if (t === P_STEAM) {                                 // curl: lateral sway grows with age
      const age = PMAXL[i] - PLIFE[i];
      PVX[i] = Math.sin(age * 3.1 + PPH[i]) * (1.5 + age * 2);
      PVY[i] = Math.cos(age * 2.3 + PPH[i]) * (1 + age);
    } else if (t === P_INK || t === P_SPARK) {
      PVZ[i] -= 40 * dt;
    } else if (t === P_PUFF) {
      PVX[i] *= 0.9; PVY[i] *= 0.9; PVZ[i] *= 0.92;
    }
    PX[i] += PVX[i] * dt; PY[i] += PVY[i] * dt; PZ[i] += PVZ[i] * dt;
    if (t === P_INK && PZ[i] < CTR_Z + 3) { PZ[i] = CTR_Z + 3; PVX[i] = PVY[i] = PVZ[i] = 0; }
  }
}
function drawParticles(start=0,end=PMAX) {
  shSunMax = 0; shFlag = 0; shFlat = true; shBias = 8;
  for (let i = start; i < end; i++) {
    const t = PTYPE[i];
    if (t === 0) continue;
    const f = PLIFE[i] / PMAXL[i];
    const x = Math.round(PX[i]), y = Math.round(PY[i]), z = Math.round(PZ[i]);
    const sx = Math.round(x - y) + tOX, sy = Math.round((x + y) * 0.5 - z) + tOY;
    if (t === P_STEAM) {
      if (f < bayer(sx + tPX + i, sy + tPY) * 0.9) continue;       // dithered fade
      dot3(x, y, z, f > 0.6 ? C.WHITE : C.SUN1, 0);
    } else if(t===6){
      if(f<bayer(sx+tPX,sy+tPY))continue;
      dot3(x,y,z,PCOL[i],0);dot3(x+1,y-1,z+1,PCOL[i],0);dot3(x,y,z+2,PCOL[i],0);
    } else if (t === P_SPARK) {
      dot3(x, y, z, PCOL[i], 0);
      if (f > 0.55) { dot3(x + 1, y - 1, z, C.WHITE, 0); dot3(x - 1, y + 1, z, C.WHITE, 0); dot3(x, y, z + 1, C.WHITE, 0); dot3(x, y, z - 1, C.WHITE, 0); }
    } else if (t === P_PUFF) {
      if (f < bayer(sx + tPX, sy + tPY)) continue;
      dot3(x, y, z, PCOL[i], 0);
    } else if (t === P_HEART) {                                    // 3 x 3 heart that fades from the bottom up
      const wob = Math.round(Math.sin(PPH[i] + (1 - f) * 7) * 0.6);
      for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
        const hx = HEART_PX[k * 2], hy = HEART_PX[k * 2 + 1];
        if (f < 0.35 && bayer(sx + hx + tPX, sy + hy + tPY) > f / 0.35) continue;
        heartPixel(sx + hx + wob, sy + hy, x + y + z, k === 0 ? C.RD4 : C.RD3);
      }
    } else {
      dot3(x, y, z, PCOL[i], 0);
    }
  }
  shFlat = false; shBias = 0;
}
const HEART_PX = new Int8Array([-1, -1, 1, -1, -1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 1]);   // (dx, dy) pairs: two bumps, a bar, the point
function heartPixel(px, py, xyz, col) {
  if (px < 0 || py < 0 || px >= tW || py >= tH) return;
  const k = py * tW + px, d = Math.round(xyz * 4) + 8;
  if (d < tDep[k]) return;
  tDep[k] = d; tIdx[k] = col; tLvl[k] = 2;
}
// ---- analytic event particles (the demo loop) ---------------------------------------------------
// Every particle is a closed-form function of its age, so events near the loop's end
// carry on past the wrap instead of being cut off. events: [{kind, t, x, y, z, seed, coat}].
function drawEvents(t, events, loop) {
  shSunMax = 0; shFlag = 0; shFlat = true; shBias = 8;
  for (let e = 0; e < events.length; e++) {
    const ev = events[e];
    let age = t - ev.t; if (age < 0) age += loop;
    if (ev.kind === 'spark') {
      for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
        const h = hash2(ev.seed * 31 + k, 7), life = 0.45 + h * 0.35;
        if (age >= life) continue;
        const a = (k / 6) * Math.PI + h * 0.4, sp = 10 + hash2(ev.seed, k * 13) * 14, f = 1 - age / life;
        const x = ev.x + (hash2(k, ev.seed) - 0.5) * 6 + Math.cos(a) * sp * 0.7 * age, y = ev.y + 1 + sp * 0.25 * age;
        const z = ev.z + (Math.sin(a) * sp * 0.6 + 6) * age - 20 * age * age;
        const col = k & 1 ? C.WHITE : (ev.coat === 'ginger' ? C.RD4 : C.BL4);
        dot3(Math.round(x), Math.round(y), Math.round(z), col, 0);
        if (f > 0.55) { dot3(Math.round(x) + 1, Math.round(y) - 1, Math.round(z), C.WHITE, 0); dot3(Math.round(x), Math.round(y), Math.round(z) + 1, C.WHITE, 0); }
      }
    } else if (ev.kind === 'heart') {
      if (age >= 1.3) continue;
      const f = 1 - age / 1.3, x = Math.round(ev.x), y = Math.round(ev.y), z = Math.round(ev.z + 5 * age);
      const sx = Math.round(x - y) + tOX, sy = Math.round((x + y) * 0.5 - z) + tOY, wob = Math.round(Math.sin(ev.seed + age * 7) * 0.6);
      for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
        const hx = HEART_PX[k * 2], hy = HEART_PX[k * 2 + 1];
        if (f < 0.35 && bayer(sx + hx + tPX, sy + hy + tPY) > f / 0.35) continue;
        heartPixel(sx + hx + wob, sy + hy, x + y + z, k === 0 ? C.RD4 : C.RD3);
      }
    } else if (ev.kind === 'puff') {
      for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
        const life = 0.35 + hash2(ev.seed, k) * 0.2;
        if (age >= life) continue;
        const a = hash2(k * 5, ev.seed) * TAU, r = 9 * age * (1 - 0.5 * age / life), f = 1 - age / life;
        const x = ev.x + Math.cos(a) * r, y = ev.y + Math.sin(a) * r, z = ev.z + 4 * age;
        const sx = Math.round(Math.round(x) - Math.round(y)) + tOX, sy = Math.round((Math.round(x) + Math.round(y)) * 0.5 - Math.round(z)) + tOY;
        if (f < bayer(sx + tPX, sy + tPY)) continue;
        dot3(Math.round(x), Math.round(y), Math.round(z), C.BG0, 0);
      }
    } else if (ev.kind === 'steam') {                                // a wisp from the tea: rises, curls wider, fades
      const life = 1.4 + hash2(ev.seed, 3) * 0.5;
      if (age >= life) continue;
      const ph = hash2(ev.seed, 5) * TAU, f = 1 - age / life;
      const x = Math.round(ev.x + (hash2(ev.seed, 7) - 0.5) + Math.sin(age * 3.1 + ph) * (0.5 + age * 0.8));
      const y = Math.round(ev.y + Math.cos(age * 2.3 + ph) * (0.3 + age * 0.4)), z = Math.round(ev.z + (5 + hash2(ev.seed, 9) * 2) * age);
      const sx = x - y + tOX, sy = Math.round((x + y) * 0.5 - z) + tOY;
      if (f < bayer(sx + tPX + ev.seed, sy + tPY) * 0.9) continue;     // dithered fade
      dot3(x, y, z, f > 0.6 ? C.WHITE : C.SUN1, 0);
    } else if (ev.kind === 'ink') {                                  // the thunk: a burst of ink dots; any that reach the counter stop there
      for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
        const life = 0.3 + hash2(ev.seed * 17 + k, 1) * 0.2;
        if (age >= life) continue;
        const a = hash2(ev.seed, k * 3 + 1) * TAU, sp = 8 + hash2(ev.seed, k * 3 + 2) * 10, vz = 10 + hash2(ev.seed, k * 3 + 3) * 8;
        const land = (vz + Math.sqrt(vz * vz + 80 * (ev.z - ev.floor))) / 40, ta = Math.min(age, land);   // z(t) = z + vz t - 20 t^2
        const x = ev.x + Math.cos(a) * sp * ta, y = ev.y + Math.sin(a) * sp * ta, z = Math.max(ev.floor, ev.z + vz * ta - 20 * ta * ta);
        dot3(Math.round(x), Math.round(y), Math.round(z), k & 1 ? C.DEEP : C.COOL1, 0);
      }
    }
  }
  shFlat = false; shBias = 0;
}

// ---- dust motes: 64 stateless motes drifting in the sunbeams ----------------------------
const NDUST = 64, DUST = new Float32Array(NDUST * 6);
function initDust() {
  rngSeed(777);
  let n = 0, guard = 0;
  while (n < NDUST && guard++ < 20000) {
    const x = 6 + rnd() * 110, y = rnd() * 100, z = 2 + rnd() * 52;
    if (windowAmt(y + SUN_M * x, z + SUN_K * x) <= 0) continue;   // seed inside the beam volume
    const o = n * 6;
    DUST[o] = x; DUST[o + 1] = y; DUST[o + 2] = z; DUST[o + 3] = rnd() * TAU; DUST[o + 4] = rnd() * TAU; DUST[o + 5] = rnd();
    n++;
  }
}
function drawDust(t) {
  shSunMax = 0; shFlag = 0; shFlat = true; shBias = 6;
  for (let k = 0; k < NDUST; k++) {
    const o = k * 6;
    const x = DUST[o] + Math.sin(t / 24 * TAU + DUST[o + 3]) * 4;
    const y = DUST[o + 1] + Math.cos(t / 16 * TAU + DUST[o + 4]) * 3;
    const z = DUST[o + 2] + Math.sin(t / 48 * TAU + DUST[o + 5] * TAU) * 5;
    if (sunFn(x, y, z, F_TOP) < 0.6) continue;                     // only visible in the light
    if (fract(t / 3 + DUST[o + 5]) < 0.18) continue;               // gentle twinkle (3 s period)
    dot3(x, y, z, DUST[o + 5] > 0.5 ? C.SUN1 : C.WHITE, 0);
  }
  shFlat = false; shBias = 0;
}
// ============================================================================
// 31 FRAME COMPOSITION: copy baked layer -> dynamic draws -> post passes -> resolve
// ============================================================================
const offCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
const offCtx = offCanvas.getContext('2d');
let img = null, img32 = null;
let viewX = 0, viewY = 0;              // world-layer px of the view's top-left
// View state set by the app layer: whole-number scale, optional user zoom (null =
// default for the mode) and a pan offset in logical px added to the camera.
const view = { scale: 1, zoom: null, panX: 0, panY: 0 };
let VIEW_CX = OX + 24, VIEW_CY = OY + 49;     // diorama centre in the world layer (a Box Room sets its own)

function allocView() {
  offCanvas.width = LW; offCanvas.height = LH;
  img = offCtx.createImageData(LW, LH);
  img32 = new Uint32Array(img.data.buffer);
  if(ACTIVE_ROOM.id==='depot')depotAllocFrame();
  if(ACTIVE_ROOM.id==='train')trainAllocView();
  paperAllocView();
}

// Copy the baked world layer under the view. Anything outside the layer is plain
// backdrop (BG0, neutral light), so tall or wide screens just show more table.
function fillBackdrop(a, b) { fIdx.fill(C.BG0, a, b); fLvl.fill(2, a, b); fDep.fill(DEPTH_EMPTY, a, b); }
function composeStatic() {
  paperBeginFrame();
  const x0 = clamp(-viewX, 0, LW), x1 = clamp(WW - viewX, 0, LW);     // view columns inside the layer
  for (let r = 0; r < LH; r++) {
    const wy = viewY + r, row = r * LW;
    if (wy < 0 || wy >= WH || x1 <= x0) { fillBackdrop(row, row + LW); continue; }
    if (x0 > 0) fillBackdrop(row, row + x0);
    if (x1 < LW) fillBackdrop(row + x1, row + LW);
    let si = wy * WW + viewX + x0, fi = row + x0;
    const end = row + x1;
    for (; fi < end; fi++, si++) { fIdx[fi] = sIdx[si]; fLvl[fi] = sLvl[si]; fDep[fi] = sDep[si]; }
  }
  composeBackdrop();
}

// Subtle dithered vignette at the frame corners (screen space).
let VIG = new Uint8Array(0);
function buildVignette() {
  if (VIG.length < LW * LH) VIG = new Uint8Array(LW * LH);
  const cx = LW / 2, cy = LH / 2;
  for (let y = 0; y < LH; y++) for (let x = 0; x < LW; x++) {
    const dx = (x - cx) / cx, dy = (y - cy) / cy;
    const d = Math.sqrt((dx * dx + dy * dy) * 0.5);
    const a = clamp((d - 0.84) / 0.3, 0, 1) * 0.8;
    VIG[y * LW + x] = a > bayer(x, y) ? 1 : 0;
  }
}
function applyVignette() {
  paperVignette = true;
  const n = LW * LH;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) if (VIG[i] && fLvl[i] > 0 && !(BD && fDep[i] === DEPTH_EMPTY)) fLvl[i]--;
}

function resolve() {                   // a colour number with bit 7 set is the board's: the second half of the table
  const n = LW * LH, T = grayscale ? GRAY32 : RES32, HALF = NLVL * PAL_N;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const v = fIdx[i]; img32[i] = T[(v >> 7) * HALF + fLvl[i] * PAL_N + (v & 127)]; }
  offCtx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
  paperResolveFrame();
}

function renderFrame() {
  paperBeginFrame();
  viewX = Math.round(VIEW_CX + WS.camX + view.panX - LW / 2);
  viewY = Math.round(VIEW_CY + WS.camY + view.panY - LH / 2);
  if(ACTIVE_ROOM.id==='depot'&&depotFastEnabled&&depotFastFrame())return;
  composeStatic();
  targetFrame(viewX, viewY);
  drawDynamic();
  postPasses();
  applyVignette();
  resolve();
}

// ---- dynamic draw list (painter's order: x + y, then z; per-pixel depth resolves ties) ----
const IT_CLOCK = 0, IT_CUBBIES = 2, IT_LANE = 4, IT_SORTER = 5, IT_CAT = 6, IT_CONVEYOR = 7, IT_LAMP = 8,
  IT_PLANTS = 9, IT_COUNTER = 10, IT_MUG = 11, IT_WALKER = 12, IT_FLOORBOX = 13;   // board items start at IT_BOARD0 (32_board)
let ITEM_ID = new Int16Array(96), ITEM_KEY = new Float32Array(96);
let nItems = 0;
let drawItemHook = null;                                             // review aid (__so.coverage): (id, after) round each item
function addItem(id, xy, z) {
  if (nItems === ITEM_ID.length) {
    const ids = new Int16Array(nItems * 2), keys = new Float32Array(nItems * 2);
    ids.set(ITEM_ID); keys.set(ITEM_KEY); ITEM_ID = ids; ITEM_KEY = keys;
  }
  ITEM_ID[nItems] = id; ITEM_KEY[nItems] = xy * 256 + z; nItems++;
}
function sortItems() {
  for (let i = 1; i < nItems; i++) {
    const id = ITEM_ID[i], k = ITEM_KEY[i];
    let j = i - 1;
    while (j >= 0 && ITEM_KEY[j] > k) { ITEM_ID[j + 1] = ITEM_ID[j]; ITEM_KEY[j + 1] = ITEM_KEY[j]; j--; }
    ITEM_ID[j + 1] = id; ITEM_KEY[j + 1] = k;
  }
}
function drawItem(id) {
  shFlat = false; shBias = 0; shFlag = 0; shSunMax = 1;
  switch (id) {
    case IT_CLOCK: drawClock(loopT); break;
    case IT_CUBBIES: drawCubbyCats(loopT, !WS.cubbyCollectEmpty); break;
    case IT_LANE: drawShelfStack(WS.shelfCount, WS.shelfLift); break;
    case IT_SORTER: {
      const s = WS.sorter;
      buildSorter();
      blitSprite(Math.round(s.x), Math.round(s.y), 0, s.face === FACE_E || s.face === FACE_N, true);
      break;
    }
    case IT_CAT: drawCat(); break;
    case IT_WALKER: drawWalker(); break;
    case IT_FLOORBOX: drawFloorBox(); break;
    case IT_CONVEYOR: drawConveyor(); break;
    case IT_LAMP: drawLamp(); break;
    case IT_PLANTS: drawPlants(loopT); break;
    case IT_COUNTER:
      if (WS.counter.stampOn) drawStampAt(STAMP_X, STAMP_Y, CTR_Z + 3);
      drawChuteFlap(WS.counter.chute);
      drawCounterBox();
      break;
    case IT_MUG: if (!WS.mugInHand) drawMugAt(MUG_X, MUG_Y, MUG_Z); break;
    default:
      if (id >= IT_BOARD0) drawBoardItem(id - IT_BOARD0);
  }
}
// COLLECT: the opened box waiting on the floor, then the sleepy cat in it before the sorter lifts it.
function drawFloorBox() {
  const B = WS.floorBox;
  shSunMax = 1; shFlag = 0; shBias = 0;
  if (B.cat) buildCatBox(COAT_GINGER, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0, true); else buildBox(0, true, false);
  blitSprite(B.x, B.y, 0, false, true);
}
function drawDynamic() { ACTIVE_ROOM.draw(); }
function drawOfficeDynamic() {
  paintWindows();
  lampFn = lampLight;
  nItems = 0;
  addItem(IT_CLOCK, CLOCK_X, 60);
  addItem(IT_CUBBIES, BANK_X0 + 7, 9);
  addItem(IT_LANE, LANE_X0 + 12, LANE_Z);
  if (GAME_MODE) { gPrepareSrc(); addBoardItems(G_SRC); }
  else { demoPrepareSrc(loopT); addBoardItems(DEMO_SRC); }
  addItem(IT_SORTER, WS.sorter.x + WS.sorter.y, 0);
  addItem(IT_CAT, cat.x + cat.y, cat.z);
  if (WS.walker.on) addItem(IT_WALKER, WS.walker.x + WS.walker.y, WS.walker.z);
  if (WS.floorBox.on) addItem(IT_FLOORBOX, WS.floorBox.x + WS.floorBox.y, 0);
  addItem(IT_CONVEYOR, CV_X1 * 0.5 + CV_Y0 + 6, CV_Z);
  addItem(IT_LAMP, LAMP_X + LAMP_Y, LAMP_Z);
  addItem(IT_PLANTS, PLANT1.x + PLANT1.y, 10);
  addItem(IT_COUNTER, 27 + 86, CTR_Z + 3);
  addItem(IT_MUG, MUG_X + MUG_Y, MUG_Z);
  sortItems();
  for (let k = 0; k < nItems; k++) {
    if (drawItemHook) drawItemHook(ITEM_ID[k], false);
    drawItem(ITEM_ID[k]);
    if (drawItemHook) drawItemHook(ITEM_ID[k], true);
  }
  drawDust(loopT);
  drawParticles();
  drawEvents(loopT, WS.events, SCN.demo.loop);
  if (!GAME_MODE) drawEvents(loopT, DEMO_D.events, SCN.demo.loop);
  lampFn = null;
  shSunMax = 2;
}

// ---- post passes on baked pixels that no dynamic draw has covered ----------------------
function viewBox(x0, y0, x1, y1, z0, z1) {     // world AABB -> view px rect in VB
  VB[0] = clamp(Math.floor(x0 - y1) + OX - viewX - 1, 0, LW - 1);
  VB[1] = clamp(Math.ceil(x1 - y0) + OX - viewX + 1, 0, LW - 1);
  VB[2] = clamp(Math.floor((x0 + y0) * 0.5 - z1) + OY - viewY - 1, 0, LH - 1);
  VB[3] = clamp(Math.ceil((x1 + y1) * 0.5 - z0) + OY - viewY + 1, 0, LH - 1);
  // post passes read the baked layer: keep the box inside it too
  if (VB[0] < -viewX) VB[0] = -viewX; if (VB[1] > WW - 1 - viewX) VB[1] = WW - 1 - viewX;
  if (VB[2] < -viewY) VB[2] = -viewY; if (VB[3] > WH - 1 - viewY) VB[3] = WH - 1 - viewY;
}
const VB = new Int32Array(4);
// Long sun shadow of a vertical caster (radius r, height h) across lit floor.
function sunShadow(cx, cy, r, h) {
  const L = h * INV_K;
  viewBox(cx - r, cy - SUN_M * L - r, cx + L + r, cy + r, 0, 0);
  const m2 = 1 + SUN_M * SUN_M;
  for (let py = VB[2]; py <= VB[3]; py++) for (let px = VB[0]; px <= VB[1]; px++) {
    const fi = py * LW + px, si = (py + viewY) * WW + px + viewX;
    if (fDep[fi] !== sDep[si]) continue;
    const f = sFlg[si], sa = f >> 6;
    if (!(f & FL_FLOOR) || sa === 0) continue;
    const X = sWX[si] * 0.25, Y = sWY[si] * 0.25;
    const s = ((X - cx) - SUN_M * (Y - cy)) / m2;
    if (s < 0 || SUN_K * s > h) continue;
    const ex = X - s - cx, ey = Y + SUN_M * s - cy, d = Math.sqrt(ex * ex + ey * ey);
    const rr = r * (1 - 0.35 * (SUN_K * s / h));
    if (d > rr + 0.6) continue;
    if (d > rr - 0.6 && bayer(px + viewX, py + viewY) < 0.5) continue;
    fLvl[fi] = fLvl[fi] > sa ? fLvl[fi] - sa : 0;
  }
}
// Soft cool contact shadow under a character's feet.
function contactShadow(cx, cy, rx, ry, dens) {
  const sx = Math.round(cx - cy) + OX - viewX, sy = Math.round((cx + cy) * 0.5) + OY - viewY;
  for (let j = -ry; j <= ry; j++) for (let i = -rx; i <= rx; i++) {
    const px = sx + i, py = sy + j;
    if (px < 0 || py < 0 || px >= LW || py >= LH) continue;
    if (px + viewX < 0 || px + viewX >= WW || py + viewY < 0 || py + viewY >= WH) continue;
    const e = (i * i) / (rx * rx) + (j * j) / (ry * ry);
    if (e > 1) continue;
    const fi = py * LW + px, si = (py + viewY) * WW + px + viewX;
    if (fDep[fi] !== sDep[si] || !(sFlg[si] & FL_FLOOR)) continue;
    if ((1 - e) * dens > bayer(px + viewX, py + viewY) && fLvl[fi] > 0) fLvl[fi]--;
  }
}
function lampPool() {
  const lx = LAMP_X + WS.lampSX * 0.5, ly = LAMP_Y - WS.lampSX * 0.5;
  viewBox(lx - LAMP_R, ly - LAMP_R, lx + LAMP_R, ly + LAMP_R, 0, LAMP_Z + 8);
  for (let py = VB[2]; py <= VB[3]; py++) for (let px = VB[0]; px <= VB[1]; px++) {
    const fi = py * LW + px, si = (py + viewY) * WW + px + viewX;
    if (fDep[fi] !== sDep[si] || !(sFlg[si] & FL_ROOM) || (sFlg[si] & FL_GLASS)) continue;
    const add = lampLight(sWX[si] * 0.25, sWY[si] * 0.25, sWZ[si] * 0.25, px + viewX, py + viewY);
    if (add && fLvl[fi] < 4) fLvl[fi]++;
  }
}
function postPasses() { ACTIVE_ROOM.post(); }
function postOfficePasses() {
  const s = WS.sorter, wk = WS.walker;
  sunShadow(s.x, s.y, 3.5, 26);
  contactShadow(s.x, s.y, 6, 2, 0.9);
  if (cat.z === 0) {                                                 // on the sill or mid-hop: no floor shadow
    sunShadow(cat.x, cat.y, 3, cat.state === CS_SLEEP ? 4 : cat.state === CS_WALK ? 7 : 8);
    contactShadow(cat.x, cat.y, 5, 2, 0.8);
  }
  if (wk.on && wk.z === 0) { sunShadow(wk.x, wk.y, 3, 7); contactShadow(wk.x, wk.y, 5, 2, 0.8); }
  if (WS.floorBox.on) contactShadow(WS.floorBox.x, WS.floorBox.y, 6, 2, 0.8);
  lampPool();
}
// ============================================================================
// 32 BOARD VIEW: draws a board from a plain description plus each cat's trace and
// clock time. The game (43_game) and the demo loop (below) both fill a BoardSrc;
// nothing here knows which one it is drawing. Swift: one BoardView fed by either.
// Pieces react to the cats' poses: hatch doors open for a pop-up, turntable rims
// turn, a bumped dog lifts an ear, baskets lose their dent when a cat curls up,
// and cat flaps swing when a napped cat goes home.
// ============================================================================
function makeBoardSrc(maxCats) {
  const s = { ox: 0, oy: 0, w: 0, h: 0, rails: false, largeBaskets: false, cursor: -1, gallery: null, hatchNumbers: false, hatchCues: false,
    extras: [], locked: [], eventTiles: [], eventFrame: 0,
    tunnels: [], tunnelFocus: -1, hatches: [], baskets: [], dogs: [], turntables: [], gates: [], flaps: [], edgeFlaps: [], // flaps: original demo wall flaps; edgeFlaps: rule destinations
    queues: [], n: 0, traces: [], poses: [], times: new Float64Array(maxCats).fill(-1) };
  for (let i = 0; i < maxCats; i++) s.poses.push(makeBoardCatPose());
  return s;
}
const IT_BOARD0 = 64, BD_FLAT = 0, BD_BASKET0 = 1, BD_DOG0 = 128, BD_CAT0 = 256, BD_BOX0 = 4096, BD_EXTRA0 = 8192, BD_PORTAL0 = 16384;
const BA_A = BOARDANIM.A;
let boardSrc = null;                                                // the board being drawn this frame
const bdX = (src, x) => src.ox + x * TILE, bdY = (src, y) => src.oy + y * TILE;
function addBoardItems(src) {
  boardSrc = src;
  addItem(IT_BOARD0 + BD_FLAT, src.ox + src.oy, 0);
  for (let k = 0; k < src.baskets.length; k++) addItem(IT_BOARD0 + BD_BASKET0 + k, bdX(src, src.baskets[k].x) + bdY(src, src.baskets[k].y) + 16, 4);
  for (let k = 0; k < src.dogs.length; k++) addItem(IT_BOARD0 + BD_DOG0 + k, bdX(src, src.dogs[k].x) + bdY(src, src.dogs[k].y) + 20, 1);
  for(let k=0;k<src.edgeFlaps.length;k++){
    const f=src.edgeFlaps[k],distance=8+(f.side<2?EDGE_PORTAL_DATA.outset:EDGE_PORTAL_DATA.backOutset);
    addItem(IT_BOARD0+BD_PORTAL0+k,bdX(src,f.x)+bdY(src,f.y)+16+(GR_DX[f.side]+GR_DY[f.side])*distance,0);
  }
  const cats = src.gallery ? src.gallery.length : src.n;
  for (let i = 0; i < cats; i++) {
    const o = src.gallery ? src.gallery[i].o : src.poses[i];
    if (!src.gallery) {
      o.takeoff=-1;o.takeoffSupported=0;
      if (src.times[i] < 0) { o.anim = BA_A.HIDDEN; o.boxFold = -1; o.flapOpen = 0; o.spinX = -1; o.bumpAge = -1; continue; }
      BOARDANIM.pose(src.traces[i], src.times[i]+(paperEnabled?1e-9:0), o);
      if(paperEnabled)paperBoardArrivalPose(o,src.traces[i],src.times[i]+1e-9);
    }
    if (o.anim !== BA_A.HIDDEN) addItem(IT_BOARD0 + BD_CAT0 + i, o.x + o.y + 8, o.z);
    if (o.boxFold >= 0 && !(paperEnabled&&(o.takeoff>=0||o.flapPose>=0))) addItem(IT_BOARD0 + BD_BOX0 + i, o.boxX + o.boxY + 8, 0);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < src.extras.length; i++) {
    const o = src.extras[i].o;
    addItem(IT_BOARD0 + BD_EXTRA0 + i, o.x + o.y + 8, o.z);
  }
}
// The strongest effect any cat has on tile (x, y) this frame.
function boardCatsAt(src, x, y, test) {
  let best = 0;
  if (src.gallery) return 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < src.n; i++) { if (src.times[i] < 0) continue; const v = test(src.poses[i], src.traces[i], x, y); if (v > best) best = v; }
  return best;
}
const bdHatchOpen = (o, tr, x, y) => o.anim === BA_A.POP && tr.hx === x && tr.hy === y ? o.hatchOpen : 0;
const bdSpin = (o, tr, x, y) => o.spinX === x && o.spinY === y ? o.spin : 0;
const bdBump = (o, tr, x, y) => o.bumpX === x && o.bumpY === y && o.bumpAge >= 0 && o.bumpAge < 0.6 ? 1 : 0;
const bdNapping = (o, tr, x, y) => (o.anim === BA_A.NAP || o.anim === BA_A.CURL || o.anim === BA_A.WAKE) && tr.n > 0 && tr.x1[tr.n - 1] === x && tr.y1[tr.n - 1] === y ? 1 : 0;
const bdFlap = (o, tr, x, y) => tr.n > 0 && tr.x1[tr.n - 1] === x ? o.flapOpen : 0;
function drawBoardItem(k) {
  const src = boardSrc;
  shSunMax = 1; shFlag = 0; shBias = 0; shFlat = false;
  if (k === BD_FLAT) {
    if (src.rails) drawBoardRails(src);
    for(const f of src.edgeFlaps)drawEdgeFlapBand(bdX(src,f.x),bdY(src,f.y),f.side,f.coat);
    for (const h of src.hatches) {
      const open=boardCatsAt(src,h.x,h.y,bdHatchOpen);
      if(ACTIVE_ROOM.id==='depot'&&depotPieceCacheEnabled&&h.depotCells)depotBlitCell(h.depotCells[open]);
      else drawHatch(bdX(src,h.x),bdY(src,h.y),h.dir,open);
    }
    for (const t of src.turntables) {
      const spin=boardCatsAt(src,t.x,t.y,bdSpin);
      if(ACTIVE_ROOM.id==='depot'&&depotPieceCacheEnabled&&t.depotCells&&spin<3)depotBlitCell(t.depotCells[spin]);
      else drawTurntable(bdX(src,t.x),bdY(src,t.y),t.dir,t.kind,spin,t.locked);
    }
    for (const g of src.gates) {
      if(pointsRulePreview)drawPointsRule(bdX(src,g.x),bdY(src,g.y),g.a,g.b,g.pose);
      else if(ACTIVE_ROOM.id==='train'||ACTIVE_ROOM.id==='cityhall'||ACTIVE_ROOM.id==='parcel')drawPoints(bdX(src,g.x),bdY(src,g.y),g.a,g.b,g.pose);
      else drawGate(bdX(src,g.x),bdY(src,g.y),g.a,g.b,g.pose);
    }
    for (const t of src.tunnels) drawTunnelPiece(src,t);
    for (let q = 0; q < src.hatches.length; q++) {
      const h = src.hatches[q], Q = src.queues[q];
      if (Q && Q.n > 0) drawHatchQueue(bdX(src, h.x), bdY(src, h.y), h.dir, Q.coats, Math.min(Q.n, 4));
    }
    for (const f of src.flaps) drawCatFlap(f.col, f.coat === COAT_GINGER, boardCatsAt(src, f.col, 0, bdFlap));
    if (src.locked.length) {
      shFlat = true; shBias = 14;
      for (const k of src.locked) {
        const x = k % src.w, y = Math.floor(k / src.w);
        faceTop(bdX(src, x), bdY(src, y), bdX(src, x) + 16, bdY(src, y) + 16, 0, shLock, C.RD2, 0);
      }
      shFlat = false; shBias = 0;
    }
    if (src.eventFrame > 0) {
      shFlat = true; shBias = 16;
      for (const k of src.eventTiles) {
        const x = k % src.w, y = Math.floor(k / src.w);
        faceTop(bdX(src, x), bdY(src, y), bdX(src, x) + 16, bdY(src, y) + 16, 0, shEvent, C.BR3, 0);
      }
      shFlat = false; shBias = 0;
    }
    if (src.cursor >= 0) {
      const cx = src.cursor % src.w, cy = Math.floor(src.cursor / src.w);
      shFlat = true; shBias = 14;
      faceTop(bdX(src, cx), bdY(src, cy), bdX(src, cx) + 16, bdY(src, cy) + 16, 0, shCursor, C.WHITE, 0);
      shFlat = false; shBias = 0;
    }
    if (src.hatchNumbers) for (let q = 0; q < src.hatches.length; q++) {
      const h = src.hatches[q]; drawHatchNumber(bdX(src, h.x), bdY(src, h.y), q + 1);
    }
  } else if (k < BD_DOG0) {
    const b = src.baskets[k - BD_BASKET0];
    if(paperEnabled&&src.largeBaskets)drawLargeBasket(bdX(src,b.x)+8,bdY(src,b.y)+8,b.coat,boardCatsAt(src,b.x,b.y,bdNapping));
    else drawBasket(bdX(src, b.x) + 8, bdY(src, b.y) + 8, b.coat, boardCatsAt(src, b.x, b.y, bdNapping));
  } else if (k < BD_CAT0) {
    const j = k - BD_DOG0, d = src.dogs[j];
    drawDog(bdX(src, d.x) + 8, bdY(src, d.y) + 8, loopT, boardCatsAt(src, d.x, d.y, bdBump), (j & 1) === 1, j * 1.7);
  } else if (k < BD_BOX0) {
    const i = k - BD_CAT0;
    if (src.gallery) drawBoardCat(src.gallery[i].o, src.gallery[i].tr); else drawBoardCat(src.poses[i], src.traces[i]);
  } else if (k < BD_EXTRA0) {
    const i = k - BD_BOX0;
    if (src.gallery) drawBoardBox(src.gallery[i].o, src.gallery[i].tr); else drawBoardBox(src.poses[i], src.traces[i]);
  } else if(k<BD_PORTAL0) {
    const cat = src.extras[k - BD_EXTRA0];
    drawBoardCat(cat.o, cat.tr);
  } else {
    const f=src.edgeFlaps[k-BD_PORTAL0];
    drawEdgePortal(bdX(src,f.x),bdY(src,f.y),f.side,f.coat,paperEnabled?paperFlapDoorState(src,f):0);
  }
}
function shLock(face, u, v) { return (u < 2 || v < 2 || u >= 14 || v >= 14) ? C.RD2 : -1; }
function shEvent(face, u, v) { return boardSrc.eventFrame % 16 < 11 && (u < 2 || v < 2 || u >= 14 || v >= 14) ? C.BR3 : -1; }
function shCursor(face, u, v) {
  if (u >= 1 && v >= 1 && u < 15 && v < 15) return -1;
  return (Math.floor(loopT * 4) & 1) ? C.WHITE : C.SUN0;
}

// ---- the demo loop's board (scene.json demo + 13_demo) ------------------------------------------
const DEMO_D = DEMO.build(SCN);
if (DEMO_D.errors.length) console.error('demo paths disagree with the rules:\n' + DEMO_D.errors.join('\n'));
if (DEMO_D.clashes.length || DEMO_D.basketOverlaps.length) console.error('demo schedule:', DEMO_D.clashes, DEMO_D.basketOverlaps);
const DEMO_SRC = (function () {
  const D = SCN.demo, s = makeBoardSrc(D.cats.length), DIR = { R: 0, D: 1, L: 2, U: 3 };
  s.ox = (GRID_I + D.board.roomX) * TILE; s.oy = (GRID_J + D.board.roomY) * TILE; s.w = D.board.w; s.h = D.board.h;   // on the stone floor
  s.hatches.push({ x: D.hatch.x, y: D.hatch.y, dir: DIR[D.hatch.dir] });
  for (const b of D.baskets) s.baskets.push({ x: b.x, y: b.y, coat: b.coat === 'ginger' ? COAT_GINGER : COAT_BLUE });
  for (const d of D.dogs) s.dogs.push({ x: d.x, y: d.y });
  for (const t of D.turntables) s.turntables.push({ x: t.x, y: t.y, dir: DIR[t.dir], kind: t.type === 'ginger' ? TT_GINGER : t.type === 'blue' ? TT_BLUE : TT_PLAIN });
  for (const f of D.flaps) s.flaps.push({ col: f.col, coat: f.coat === 'ginger' ? COAT_GINGER : COAT_BLUE });
  s.n = DEMO_D.traces.length;
  for (let i = 0; i < s.n; i++) s.traces.push(DEMO_D.traces[i]);
  s.queues.push({ coats: new Uint8Array(4), n: 0 });
  return s;
})();
// Each frame: which cats are out (and at what time on their own clock), and who's next up the hatch.
function demoPrepareSrc(t) {
  const s = DEMO_SRC, Q = s.queues[0];
  for (let i = 0; i < s.n; i++) s.times[i] = DEMO.active(DEMO_D, t, i);
  let next = 0, best = 1e9;                                          // the next cat to pop up waits on the lid
  for (let i = 0; i < s.n; i++) {
    let dt = DEMO_D.cats[i].rel - SCN.demo.pop - t;
    if (dt < 0) dt += SCN.demo.loop;
    if (dt < best) { best = dt; next = i; }
  }
  Q.n = best < 2.5 ? 1 : 0;
  Q.coats[0] = DEMO_D.cats[next].coat === 'ginger' ? COAT_GINGER : COAT_BLUE;
}
// Raised start arrow: cached indexed artwork and a world-anchored annotation.
// It never changes rule/index/depth buffers or allocates in the frame path.
const HATCH_CUE_TEXTURES=[];
function hatchCueFade(age){const t=clamp(age/.3,0,1);return 1-t*t*(3-2*t);}
function hatchCueTexture(dir,shadow){
  const dx=GR_DX[dir],dy=GR_DY[dir],shape=[-3.5,-.85,.2,-.85,.2,-2.1,4.1,0,.2,2.1,.2,.85,-3.5,.85];
  const top=new Float64Array(14),bottom=new Float64Array(14),z=shadow?0:8.4;
  for(let i=0;i<14;i+=2){const t=shape[i]+4.5,v=shape[i+1],x=dx*t-dy*v,y=dy*t+dx*v;top[i]=bottom[i]=x-y;top[i+1]=(x+y)*.5-z;bottom[i+1]=(x+y)*.5-(shadow?0:7.7);}
  const family=(shadow?'hatch_shadow_':'hatch_start_')+GR_DIRS[dir];
  const r={id:family+'/idle',family,frame:'idle',isPiece:true,x:-12,y:-16,dx:-12,dy:-16,w:24,h:24,pixels:new Uint8Array(96*96).fill(EMPTY),direction:['E','S','W','N'][dir],mirroredFor:'none',cueOpacity:shadow?.22:1,cuePlane:z};
  function paint(poly,x,y,fill){let inside=false,near=false;
    for(let i=0,j=12;i<14;j=i,i+=2){const ax=poly[j],ay=poly[j+1],bx=poly[i],by=poly[i+1];if((ay>y)!==(by>y)&&x<(bx-ax)*(y-ay)/(by-ay)+ax)inside=!inside;
      const vx=bx-ax,vy=by-ay,t=clamp(((x-ax)*vx+(y-ay)*vy)/(vx*vx+vy*vy),0,1),a=x-ax-vx*t,b=y-ay-vy*t;if(a*a+b*b<=.24*.24)near=true;}
    return !shadow&&near?C.DEEP:inside?fill:EMPTY;
  }
  for(let y=0;y<96;y++)for(let x=0;x<96;x++){const sx=r.dx+(x+.5)/4,sy=r.dy+(y+.5)/4;let c=shadow?paint(top,sx,sy,C.WD0):paint(bottom,sx,sy,C.BR1);if(!shadow){const t=paint(top,sx,sy,C.CREAM);if(t!==EMPTY)c=t;}r.pixels[y*96+x]=c;}
  return r;
}
function hatchCueInstall(records,selectors){
  if(!HATCH_CUE_TEXTURES.length)for(let i=0;i<8;i++)HATCH_CUE_TEXTURES.push(hatchCueTexture(i&3,i>=4));
  selectors[11]=HATCH_CUE_TEXTURES;for(let i=0;i<8;i++)records.push(HATCH_CUE_TEXTURES[i]);
}
function hatchCueBlend(r,cx,cy,alpha){
  if(alpha<=0)return;
  const S=paperRenderScale(),W=LW*S,ax=Math.round((cx-cy+OX-viewX+.5)*S),ay=Math.round(((cx+cy)*.5+OY-viewY+.5)*S),T=grayscale?GRAY32:RES32,offset=NLVL*PAL_N+2*PAL_N;
  for(let y=0;y<r.h*S;y++){const py=ay+r.dy*S+y;if(py<0||py>=LH*S)continue;const sy=Math.floor(y/S)*4+paperSampleOffset(y%S,S),depth=(cx+cy)*4+8*(r.dy+(y+.5)/S)+12*r.cuePlane+8;
    for(let x=0;x<r.w*S;x++){const px=ax+r.dx*S+x;if(px<0||px>=W)continue;const sx=Math.floor(x/S)*4+paperSampleOffset(x%S,S),c=r.pixels[sy*r.w*4+sx];if(c===EMPTY)continue;
      const p=py*W+px;if(paperDepth[p]>depth)continue;
      const a=alpha*r.cueOpacity,src=T[offset+c],dst=paperRGBA[p],red=Math.round((src&255)*a+(dst&255)*(1-a)),green=Math.round((src>>>8&255)*a+(dst>>>8&255)*(1-a)),blue=Math.round((src>>>16&255)*a+(dst>>>16&255)*(1-a));paperRGBA[p]=(0xff000000|blue<<16|green<<8|red)>>>0;
    }
  }
}
function hatchCueResolve(src){
  if(!src||!src.hatchCues)return;
  for(let i=0;i<src.hatches.length;i++){const h=src.hatches[i];if(!(h.cueAlpha>0))continue;const inset=h.cueInset||0,cx=src.ox+h.x*TILE+8-inset*GR_DX[h.dir],cy=src.oy+h.y*TILE+8-inset*GR_DY[h.dir];hatchCueBlend(HATCH_CUE_TEXTURES[h.dir+4],cx,cy,h.cueAlpha);hatchCueBlend(HATCH_CUE_TEXTURES[h.dir],cx,cy,h.cueAlpha);}
}
// ============================================================================
// 33 ATLAS (S): every board sprite frame at neutral light (no sun, AO or lamp),
// one sprite per row, frames left to right with 1 px padding. Each pixel keeps
// its palette index at the neutral level, whether it is outline, and the
// selective sunlit-outline colour, so a native renderer can relight it with the
// same ramps (D7). Rasteriser pieces and pixel sprites both draw into a scratch
// cell round a reference tile, exactly as the board draws them, so every
// sprite's anchor is the projected world point it is drawn at (tile centre for
// pieces and cats, the particle's own point for particles). Only unique frames
// are stored; the game holds some of them for several frames.
// Swift: a texture atlas plus JSON, loaded by the board view.
// ============================================================================
const AC = 128, ACX = 64, ACY = 96;                                 // scratch cell; world (8, 8, 0) projects to (ACX, ACY) (room above for tall pieces)
let aSize=AC, aOriginX=ACX, aOriginY=ACY;
let aIdx = new Uint8Array(AC * AC), aLvl = new Uint8Array(AC * AC), aDep = new Int16Array(AC * AC);
let aCls = new Uint8Array(AC * AC), aSel = new Uint8Array(AC * AC);
function atlasCell(size=AC) {
  if(size!==aSize){aSize=size;aOriginX=size/2;aOriginY=size===AC?ACY:size/2;
    aIdx=new Uint8Array(size*size);aLvl=new Uint8Array(size*size);aDep=new Int16Array(size*size);aCls=new Uint8Array(size*size);aSel=new Uint8Array(size*size);}

  aIdx.fill(255); aLvl.fill(2); aDep.fill(DEPTH_EMPTY); aCls.fill(0); aSel.fill(0);
  targetCustom(aIdx, aLvl, aDep, aSize, aSize, aOriginX, aOriginY - 8);
  aoFn = null; lampFn = null; shSunMax = 0; shFlag = 0; shFlat = false; shBias = 0; blitClipZ = -1e9; shBoard = 0;
}
// blitSprite at neutral light, also keeping each outline pixel's class and selective colour.
function atlasBlit(fx, fy, fz, mirror) {
  const ax = Math.round(fx - fy) + tOX, ay = Math.round((fx + fy) * 0.5 - fz) + tOY, d0 = (fx + fy + fz) * 4;
  for (let y = 0; y < SHT; y++) {
    const py = ay + (y - AY);
    if (py < 0 || py >= aSize) continue;
    for (let x = 0; x < SW; x++) {
      const c = SPR[y * SW + x];
      if (c === EMPTY) continue;
      const px = ax + (mirror ? AX - x : x - AX);
      if (px < 0 || px >= aSize) continue;
      const i = py * aSize + px, dep = Math.round(d0 + (AY - y) * 4) + 2;
      if (dep < aDep[i]) continue;
      aDep[i] = dep; aLvl[i] = 2;
      if (c === 253) { aIdx[i] = C.OUT; aCls[i] = 1; aSel[i] = SPO[y * SW + x]; } else { aIdx[i] = c; aCls[i] = 0; aSel[i] = 0; }
    }
  }
}
function shTileSide(face, u, v) { return face === F_Y ? C.FT1 : C.FT0; }

// ---- the sprite list (D6) ---------------------------------------------------------------------
const AT_DIRS = ['E', 'S', 'W', 'N'], AT_TT = ['plain', 'ginger', 'blue'];
const AT_COATS = [[COAT_GINGER, 'ginger'], [COAT_BLUE, 'blue']];
function atlasSprites() {
  const S = [];
  const spr = (name, direction, mirroredFor, fps, loop, frames) => S.push({ name, direction, mirroredFor, fps, loop, frames });
  const fr = (tag, draw) => ({ tag, draw });
  const catBox = (coat, dir, head, ears, eyes, bob, st) => () => { buildCatBox(coat, dir, head, ears, eyes, bob, st, coat === COAT_GINGER); atlasBlit(12, 12, 0, false); };
  const loose = (coat, pose, frame, look, x, y) => () => { buildLoose(coat, pose, frame, look); atlasBlit(x === undefined ? 8 : x, y === undefined ? 8 : y, 0, false); };

  spr('floor_tile', 'none', 'none', 0, false, [fr('stone', () => {
    box(0, 0, -2, 16, 16, 0, shTileSide, C.PL0, 6); faceTop(0, 0, 16, 16, 0, shStone, C.FT0, 0);
  })]);
  for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) for (let d = 0; d < 4; d++) {        // rim marks march round in 3 steps while a cat turns
    spr('turntable_' + AT_TT[k] + '_' + AT_DIRS[d], AT_DIRS[d], 'none', 10, false,
      [0, 1, 2, 3].map((s) => fr(s ? 'spin' + s : 'idle', () => drawTurntable(0, 0, d, k, s, false)))
        .concat([fr('locked', () => drawTurntable(0, 0, d, k, 0, true))]));   // a hint's turntable
  }
  for (let d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
    spr('hatch_' + AT_DIRS[d], AT_DIRS[d], 'none', 10, false, ['closed', 'ajar', 'open'].map((t, o) => fr(t, () => drawHatch(0, 0, d, o))));
  }
  spr('dog', 'none', 'none', 10, true, ['rest', 'breath', 'flop', 'lift'].map((t, f) => fr(t, () => { buildDog(f); atlasBlit(10, 10, 0, false); })));
  for (const [coat, cn] of AT_COATS) {                             // baskets: empty (dented cushion), one cat napping, two
    const nap = (f, two) => () => {
      drawBasket(8, 8, coat, 1);
      buildLoose(coat, 'curl', f, 0); atlasBlit(8, 8, 0, false);
      if (two) { buildLoose(coat, 'curl', f ^ 1, 0); atlasBlit(11, 5, 0, false); }
    };
    spr('basket_' + cn, 'none', 'none', 10, true, [fr('empty', () => drawBasket(8, 8, coat, 0)),
      fr('one_cat0', nap(0, false)), fr('one_cat1', nap(1, false)), fr('two_cats0', nap(0, true)), fr('two_cats1', nap(1, true))]);
  }
  for (const [coat, cn] of AT_COATS) {                             // cats in boxes: every direction, the box keeps its lighting
    for (const [dir, name] of [[1, 'towards'], [0, 'towards_E'], [2, 'away'], [3, 'away_N']]) {
      const frames = [fr('idle0', catBox(coat, dir, dir, 0, 0, 0, 0)), fr('idle1', catBox(coat, dir, dir, 0, 0, 1, 0)),
        fr('blink', catBox(coat, dir, dir, 0, 1, 0, 0)), fr('twitch', catBox(coat, dir, dir, 1, 0, 0, 0)),
        fr('ears_back', catBox(coat, dir, dir, 2, 0, 0, 0))];
      for (let h = 0; h < 4; h++) if (h !== dir) frames.push(fr('head_' + AT_DIRS[h], catBox(coat, dir, h, 0, 0, 0, 0)));
      spr('cat_' + cn + '_box_' + name, AT_DIRS[dir], 'none', 10, true, frames);
    }
  }
  for (const [coat, cn] of AT_COATS) {                             // loose cats are side views: S and W as drawn, E and N mirrored
    spr('cat_' + cn + '_arrive', 'S', 'E', 10, false, [fr('stretch1', catBox(coat, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1)), fr('stretch2', catBox(coat, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 2)),
      fr('hop', loose(coat, 'stretch', 0, 0)), fr('turn0', loose(coat, 'sit', 0, 0)), fr('turn1', loose(coat, 'sitfront', 0, 0)),
      fr('curl', loose(coat, 'curl', 0, 0)), fr('curl_breath', loose(coat, 'curl', 1, 0))]);
    spr('cat_' + cn + '_leave', 'S', 'E', 10, false, [fr('yawn', loose(coat, 'yawn', 0, 0)), fr('stretch', loose(coat, 'stretch', 0, 0)),
      fr('walk0', loose(coat, 'walk', 0, 0)), fr('walk1', loose(coat, 'walk', 1, 0))]);
    spr('cat_' + cn + '_puzzled', 'S', 'E', 5, true, [0, 1, 2].map((k) => fr('flick' + k, loose(coat, 'sitfront', 0, k))));
  }
  spr('qmark', 'none', 'none', 2, true, [0, 1].map((b) => fr('bob' + b, () => {
    sprClear(); KEY = KEY_GIN; tpl(QMARK, AX - 1, AY - 4 - b); KEY = KEY_S; outlineSprite(); atlasBlit(8, 8, 0, false);
  })));
  const folds = [];                                                // the emptied box: open, folding in 3 frames, flat
  for (const [red, tn] of [[true, 'red'], [false, 'blue']]) {
    ['open', 'fold1', 'fold2', 'fold3', 'flat'].forEach((t, f) => folds.push(fr(tn + '_' + t, () => { buildBox(f, red, false); atlasBlit(12, 12, 0, false); })));
  }
  spr('box_fold', 'none', 'none', 10, false, folds);
  const sparks = [];                                               // a coloured dot with white glints (as drawEvents)
  for (const [col, tn] of [[C.RD4, 'ginger'], [C.BL4, 'blue']]) {
    sparks.push(fr(tn + '_big', () => { dot3(8, 8, 0, col, 0); dot3(9, 7, 0, C.WHITE, 0); dot3(7, 9, 0, C.WHITE, 0); dot3(8, 8, 1, C.WHITE, 0); dot3(8, 8, -1, C.WHITE, 0); }));
    sparks.push(fr(tn + '_small', () => { dot3(8, 8, 0, col, 0); dot3(9, 7, 0, C.WHITE, 0); dot3(8, 8, 1, C.WHITE, 0); }));
    sparks.push(fr(tn + '_dot', () => dot3(8, 8, 0, col, 0)));
  }
  spr('sparkle', 'none', 'none', 10, false, sparks);
  spr('heart', 'none', 'none', 10, false, [1, 0.25, 0.12].map((f, k) => fr(['full', 'fade1', 'fade2'][k], () => {
    for (let j = 0; j < 6; j++) {                                  // fades from the bottom up, as drawEvents dithers it
      const hx = HEART_PX[j * 2], hy = HEART_PX[j * 2 + 1];
      if (f < 0.35 && bayer(ACX + hx, ACY + hy) > f / 0.35) continue;
      heartPixel(ACX + hx, ACY + hy, 16, j === 0 ? C.RD4 : C.RD3);
    }
  })));
  spr('zzz', 'none', 'none', 0, false, [fr('small', () => drawZ(8, 8, 0, false, 0)), fr('big', () => drawZ(8, 8, 0, true, 0))]);
  spr('queue_head', 'none', 'none', 0, false, AT_COATS.map(([coat, cn]) => fr(cn, () => {
    KEY = coatKeyOf(coat); sprClear(); tpl(QUEUE_HEAD, AX - 2, AY - 3); KEY = KEY_S; outlineSprite(); atlasBlit(8, 8, 0.5, false);
  })));
  const festive=christmasAtlasSprites();
  return S.concat(boxAtlasSprites(), depotAtlasSprites(),trainAtlasSprites(),pointsAtlasSprites(),trainChapterAtlasSprites(),cityHallAtlasSprites(),tunnelPieceAtlasSprites(),cityHallChapterAtlasSprites(),parcelAtlasSprites(),parcelChapterAtlasSprites(),festive.filter(s=>s.name!=='christmas_evergreen'),christmasCostumeAtlasSprites(),christmasMovingAtlasSprites(),festive.filter(s=>s.name==='christmas_evergreen'),christmasChapterAtlasSprites());
}

// ---- render, crop, pack -------------------------------------------------------------------
// Returns { w, h, idx, cls, sel, json, paletteJson }: idx is the palette index of each pixel at
// neutral light (255 = transparent), cls 1 for outline pixels, sel their selective outline colour.
const ATLAS_MAX_W = 512;
function buildAtlas() {
  const keep = { ao: aoFn, lamp: lampFn };
  const list = atlasSprites(), blocks = [];
  for (const s of list) {
    const cells = [], cellSize=s.cellSize||AC, originX=cellSize/2, originY=cellSize===AC?ACY:cellSize/2;
    let x0 = cellSize, y0 = cellSize, x1 = -1, y1 = -1;
    for (const f of s.frames) {
      atlasCell(cellSize); f.draw(); KEY = KEY_S;
      const idx = new Uint8Array(cellSize * cellSize);
      for (let i = 0; i < cellSize * cellSize; i++) {
        if (aIdx[i] === 255) { idx[i] = 255; continue; }
        idx[i] = LUT[clamp(aLvl[i], 0, 4) * PAL_N + (aIdx[i]&127)];              // the colour it shows at neutral light
        const x = i % cellSize, y = (i / cellSize) | 0;
        if (x < x0) x0 = x; if (x > x1) x1 = x; if (y < y0) y0 = y; if (y > y1) y1 = y;
      }
      cells.push({ idx, cls: aCls.slice(), sel: aSel.slice() });
    }
    if (x1 < 0) { x0 = y0 = 0; x1 = y1 = 0; }
    const w = x1 - x0 + 1, h = y1 - y0 + 1, perRow = Math.max(1, Math.floor((ATLAS_MAX_W + 1) / (w + 1)));
    blocks.push({ s, cells, cellSize, originX, originY, x0, y0, w, h, perRow, lines: Math.ceil(cells.length / perRow) });
  }
  aoFn = keep.ao; lampFn = keep.lamp; shSunMax = 2; shFlat = false; shBias = 0; shFlag = 0; blitClipZ = -1e9;
  targetStatic();
  let W = 0, H = 0;
  for (const b of blocks) { W = Math.max(W, Math.min(b.cells.length, b.perRow) * (b.w + 1) - 1); b.top = H; H += b.lines * (b.h + 1); }
  H = Math.max(1, H - 1);
  const idx = new Uint8Array(W * H).fill(255), cls = new Uint8Array(W * H), sel = new Uint8Array(W * H), sprites = [];
  for (const b of blocks) {
    const frames = [];
    b.cells.forEach((c, k) => {
      const fx = (k % b.perRow) * (b.w + 1), fy = b.top + Math.floor(k / b.perRow) * (b.h + 1);
      for (let y = 0; y < b.h; y++) for (let x = 0; x < b.w; x++) {
        const si = (b.y0 + y) * b.cellSize + b.x0 + x, di = (fy + y) * W + fx + x;
        idx[di] = c.idx[si]; cls[di] = c.idx[si] === 255 ? 0 : c.cls[si]; sel[di] = c.idx[si] === 255 ? 0 : c.sel[si];
      }
      frames.push({ x: fx, y: fy, tag: b.s.frames[k].tag, ...(b.s.frames[k].poses?{poses:b.s.frames[k].poses}:{}), ...(b.s.frames[k].sample!==undefined?{sample:b.s.frames[k].sample}:{}) });
    });
    sprites.push({ name: b.s.name, direction: b.s.direction, mirroredFor: b.s.mirroredFor, fps: b.s.fps, loop: b.s.loop,
      size: { w: b.w, h: b.h }, anchor: { x: b.originX - b.x0, y: b.originY - b.y0 }, ...(b.s.origin?{origin:b.s.origin,light:b.s.light||'room'}:{}), frames });
  }
  const json = {
    version: 1, image: 'atlas.png', indexImage: 'atlas-index.png', palette: 'palette.json',
    tile: { w: 32, h: 16, worldUnits: TILE }, fps: 10,
    notes: [
      'anchor: the pixel at the projected world point the sprite is drawn at: the tile centre for floor pieces, cats, boxes and the dog; the point itself for particles',
      'cats in boxes are drawn for all 4 directions because the box keeps its lighting; loose cats are side views (mirroredFor: the frames flipped)',
      'unique frames only: the game holds frames (the dog flops an ear for 3 frames, a hopping cat moves along an arc on one frame)',
      'atlas-index.png: R palette index, G 1 for outline pixels, B the outline pixel\'s sunlit colour, A 255 opaque',
      'Box Room pieces (box_, brick_gap_, skylight_, roof_, beam, lamp, string_bulb, the props, the seasonal things, nap_): the anchor is the pixel of the piece\'s own origin, the min corner (x0, y0, z0) of its box in sim/18_boxroom data (boxes, props, items); the bottom back corner of a wall panel; the low back corner of a skylight on its slope; the bottom centre of a lamp\'s shade; a napping cat\'s feet. _L and _R pieces face the left wall (front +x, direction E) or the right wall (front +y, direction S); props are drawn facing each way',
      'Depot pieces use their data origin; characters use their feet. Frame poses are exact parameter keys; sample is a 60 Hz loop frame. Assemblies place separately paletted sprite layers relative to their own origin.',
      'nap_ cats: calico and tortoiseshell patches are drawn here at seed 0; the game varies them with each cat\'s seed (render/36_coats coatPixel)',
    ],
    sprites,
    assemblies:depotAtlasAssemblies(), trainScene:trainAtlasAssemblies(), points:pointsAtlasContract(),cityHallScene:cityHallAtlasAssemblies(),parcelScene:parcelAtlasAssemblies(),christmasScene:christmasAtlasContract(),tunnelPiece:tunnelPieceContract(),backdrops:'backdrops.json',
  };
  return { w: W, h: H, idx, cls, sel, json, paletteJson: paletteJson(), backdropsJson: {version:1,rooms:{office:null,boxroom:'town',depot:'depot',train:'train',cityhall:null,parcel:null},profiles:BACKDROP_DATA} };
}
function paletteJson() {
  const hex = (i) => '#' + PAL_DEF[i][1].toLowerCase(), lut = [], grey = [];
  for (let l = 0; l < NLVL; l++) lut.push(Array.from(LUT.subarray(l * PAL_N, l * PAL_N + NPAL)));
  for (let i = 0; i < NPAL; i++) { const g = GRAY32[2 * PAL_N + i] & 255; grey.push('#' + g.toString(16).padStart(2, '0').repeat(3)); }
  const lightSets = {};                                // the Box Room's time of day: one LUT per set (20_palette)
  for (const name of Object.keys(LIGHT_LUTS)) { lightSets[name] = []; for (let l = 0; l < NLVL; l++) lightSets[name].push(Array.from(LIGHT_LUTS[name].subarray(l * PAL_N, l * PAL_N + NPAL))); }
  const boardLightSets = {};                           // the board's light in each set: a colour number with bit 7 set uses it
  for (const name of Object.keys(BOARD_LUTS)) { boardLightSets[name] = []; for (let l = 0; l < NLVL; l++) boardLightSets[name].push(Array.from(BOARD_LUTS[name].subarray(l * PAL_N, l * PAL_N + NPAL))); }
  return { size: NPAL, maxColours: PAL_N, levels: NLVL, neutralLevel: 2,
    colours: PAL_DEF.map((p, i) => ({ index: i, name: p[0], hex: hex(i), sh: SH[i], lit: LITC[i] })), lut, grayscale: grey, lightSets, boardLightSets };
}
// ============================================================================
// 34 BOX ROOM: bakes a generated attic (sim/18_boxroom: plain data) into the world layer with the scene's own
// rasterisers, ramps and depth: the base, floorboards, the stone board and its kerb, brick knee walls with
// their gaps and round windows, the roof band (boarded slopes, rafters, skylights, the cut edges), the cross
// beams and the box stacks with their flaps, tape, string, labels and paw prints.
// Light: lightAt asks sunFn, which here is the room's patches. Only tops are lit, and a point at height z
// counts where its drop along the light, (x + a z, y + b z), lands; things standing on the floor margins
// shade it. useBoxRoom(room) points the renderer at a room; useOffice() points it back.
// Swift: the same bake into the indexed layer (or meshes from the same data and the same light test).
// ============================================================================
let BOXR = null;                           // the Box Room on show (BOXROOM data), or null: the sorting office
const F_SLOPE = 3;                         // face id of the roof slopes' inner faces (never sunlit)
const BX_SOFT = 1.2, BX_BAR = BOXROOM.CFG.skylights.barW, BX_PITCH = BOXROOM.CFG.roof.pitchNum / BOXROOM.CFG.roof.pitchDen;
let bxA = 0, bxB = 0, bxVZ = 48, bxP = [], bxOcc = [], bxAbove = null, bxGrid = null, bxSet = 'fri', bxLamps = [], bxNapAt = new Float32Array(0);

function activateBoxRoom(room) {
  BOXR = room;
  const L = room.light;
  bxA = L.a / L.den; bxB = L.b / L.den; bxVZ = L.virtualZ;
  bxP = L.sun ? room.patches.map(bxPrep) : [];
  bxOcc = [];                                                     // what stands on the floor margins shades the light (as in sim/18)
  for (const q of room.boxes) if (q.wall === 'F') bxOcc.push([q.x0, q.y0, q.z0, q.x1, q.y1, q.z1]);
  for (const q of room.props) bxOcc.push([q.x0, q.y0, q.z0, q.x1, q.y1, q.z1]);
  for (const q of room.items) if (q.z0 === 0) bxOcc.push([q.x0, q.y0, q.z0, q.x1, q.y1, q.z1]);
  for (const l of room.lamps) if (l.z0 < bxVZ) bxOcc.push([l.x - l.r, l.y - l.r, l.z0, l.x + l.r, l.y + l.r, l.z1]);
  bxSet = L.set;
  bxLamps = room.lamps.slice(0, L.lamps);                         // the lamps that are on
  // Each napping cat stands its sprite on the front edge of its box top (as the cubby cats do on their cushions),
  // so the top it lies on is never nearer the camera than it is; a cat on a blanket lies on the blanket.
  bxNapAt = new Float32Array(room.naps.length * 3);
  room.naps.forEach((n, k) => {
    const b = room.boxes[n.top];
    bxNapAt[k * 3] = n.wall === 'L' ? b.x1 : n.x; bxNapAt[k * 3 + 1] = n.wall === 'L' ? n.y : b.y1;
    bxNapAt[k * 3 + 2] = n.z + (room.dressing.blankets.indexOf(n.top) >= 0 ? 0.5 : 0);
  });
  bxInitDust(room);
}
function activateOffice() {
  BOXR = null;

}

// ---- sunlight through the skylights ------------------------------------------------------------
function bxPrep(p) {
  const det = p.e1[0] * p.e2[1] - p.e1[1] * p.e2[0];
  return { x: p.x, y: p.y, e1: p.e1, e2: p.e2, n1: p.panes[0], n2: p.panes[1], det,
    h1: Math.abs(det) / Math.hypot(p.e2[0], p.e2[1]), h2: Math.abs(det) / Math.hypot(p.e1[0], p.e1[1]) };
}
// 0..1 for the floor point (x, y) in patch p: soft at the edges and along the frame bars, as the windows are.
function bxPatchAmt(p, x, y) {
  const dx = x - p.x, dy = y - p.y;
  const s = (dx * p.e2[1] - dy * p.e2[0]) / p.det, t = (p.e1[0] * dy - p.e1[1] * dx) / p.det;
  if (s <= 0 || s >= 1 || t <= 0 || t >= 1) return 0;
  let m = (s < 0.5 ? s : 1 - s) * p.h1;
  const mt = (t < 0.5 ? t : 1 - t) * p.h2; if (mt < m) m = mt;
  for (let k = 1; k < p.n1; k++) { const d = Math.abs(s - k / p.n1) * p.h1 - BX_BAR / 2; if (d < m) m = d; }
  for (let k = 1; k < p.n2; k++) { const d = Math.abs(t - k / p.n2) * p.h2 - BX_BAR / 2; if (d < m) m = d; }
  return clamp(m / BX_SOFT + 0.35, 0, 1);
}
// Does anything standing on the floor margins block the light on its way to (x, y, z)?
function bxShaded(x, y, z) {
  for (let k = 0; k < bxOcc.length; k++) {
    const o = bxOcc[k];
    let t0 = Math.max(o[2], z + 0.05), t1 = Math.min(o[5], bxVZ);       // heights along the ray
    const ax0 = z + (x - o[3]) / bxA, ax1 = z + (x - o[0]) / bxA; if (ax0 > t0) t0 = ax0; if (ax1 < t1) t1 = ax1;
    const ay0 = z + (y - o[4]) / bxB, ay1 = z + (y - o[1]) / bxB; if (ay0 > t0) t0 = ay0; if (ay1 < t1) t1 = ay1;
    if (t0 < t1) return true;
  }
  return false;
}
function bxSun(x, y, z, face) {
  if (face !== F_TOP || z > bxVZ || !bxP.length) return 0;
  const fx = x + bxA * z, fy = y + bxB * z;
  let a = 0;
  for (let k = 0; k < bxP.length; k++) { const v = bxPatchAmt(bxP[k], fx, fy); if (v > a) a = v; }
  return a > 0 && bxShaded(x, y, z) ? 0 : a;
}

// ---- contact shadows -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Floor next to a standing paper layer loses a level in a narrow overlap.
function bxBuildAO(R) {
  const W = R.room.w, D = R.room.d;
  bxGrid = new Uint8Array(W * D);
  const foot = (b) => { for (let y = Math.floor(b.y0); y < b.y1; y++) for (let x = Math.floor(b.x0); x < b.x1; x++) bxGrid[y * W + x] = 1; };
  for (const b of R.boxes) if (b.z0 === 0) foot(b);
  for (const p of R.props) if (p.kind !== 'rug') foot(p);
  for (const it of R.items) if (it.z0 === 0 && it.kind !== 'sleepingCat') foot(it);
  bxAbove = new Int16Array(R.boxes.length).fill(-1);
  for (const c of R.columns) for (let k = 1; k < c.boxes.length; k++) bxAbove[c.boxes[k - 1]] = c.boxes[k];
}
function bxAO(x, y, z, face, wpx, wpy) {
  if (face !== F_TOP || z > 0.5) return 0;
  const R = BOXR, B = R.board;
  if (x >= B.x - 2 && x < B.x + B.w * TILE + 2 && y >= B.y - 2 && y < B.y + B.h * TILE + 2) return 0;
  let d = Math.min(x, y);
  const W = R.room.w, cx = Math.floor(x), cy = Math.floor(y);
  for (let j = -2; j <= 2 && d > 0; j++) for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {
    const gx = cx + i, gy = cy + j;
    if (gx < 0 || gy < 0 || gx >= W || gy >= R.room.d || !bxGrid[gy * W + gx]) continue;
    const e = Math.max(Math.abs(i) - 0.5, Math.abs(j) - 0.5, 0);
    if (e < d) d = e;
  }
  return d < 1.1 ? 1 : 0;
}

// ---- lamps: a warm pool under each lamp that's on, baked (and lampFn for anything drawn each frame) -------
// Like the office lamp: the shade blocks upward light; nested flat pools use at most two levels.
function bxLampAdd(x, y, z, wpx, wpy) {
  let add = 0;
  for (let k = 0; k < bxLamps.length; k++) {
    const l = bxLamps[k], lz = l.z0 - 1;
    if (z > lz + 2) continue;
    const dx = x - l.x, dy = y - l.y, dz = (z - lz) * 0.35, d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);
    if (d >= l.pool) continue;
    const a = 1 - d / l.pool, n = a * 3.4 + 0.25;
    const v = n >= 2 ? 2 : n >= 1 ? 1 : 0;
    if (v > add) add = v;
  }
  return add;
}
// aoFn while baking: contact shadow, less lamp light. A lamp doesn't add to the sun (a pixel takes the brighter of the
// two: lightAt has just set sunAdd), and on the board it lifts the stone a level at most, as the sun does.
function bxBakeLight(x, y, z, face, wpx, wpy) {
  const lamp = Math.min(bxLampAdd(x, y, z, wpx, wpy), shBoard ? 1 : 2);
  return bxAO(x, y, z, face, wpx, wpy) - Math.max(0, lamp - sunAdd);
}
function shBxBulb(face, dx, dy) { shFlat = true; return C.GL0; }
function shBxBulbOff(face, dx, dy) { return C.PAPSH; }
function bxLamp(l, on, beamZ) {
  shSunMax = 1; shFlag = 0;
  for (let z = beamZ - 2; z > l.z1; z -= 1) dot3(l.x, l.y, z, C.DEEP, 0);    // the flex up to the beam
  const z = l.z0;
  cylinder(l.x, l.y, 1.0, z + 6.5, z + 8, shRing, C.BR0, false);
  cylinder(l.x, l.y, 2.2, z + 5, z + 6.5, shRing, C.BR0, false);
  cylinder(l.x, l.y, 3.6, z + 3.5, z + 5, shRing, C.BR0, false);
  cylinder(l.x, l.y, 4.6, z + 1.5, z + 3.5, shRing, C.BR0, false);
  cylinder(l.x, l.y, 5.2, z, z + 1.5, shRim, C.BR0, true);
  disc(l.x, l.y, 2.0, z - 0.6, on ? shBxBulb : shBxBulbOff, on ? C.GL0 : C.PAPSH, false);
  shFlat = false;
}

// ---- the sky in the windows: by light
